text: Ngaphakathi kwedolobha elincane laseMkhanyakude, kwakukhona ibhizinisi elincane elibizwa ngokuthi "Izimanga Zothando." Le bhizinisi yayithengisa izipho ezihlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi ezokubhalela, kodwa yayidla kanzima ngenxa yokuncintisana okukhulu. Umnini wayo, uNokuthula, wayefuna indlela yokwenza ibhizinisi lakhe likhule futhi lithole amakhasimende amasha. Ngolunye usuku, uNokuthula wathola ithuba lokuphendula izidingo zabalakishi abasha. Waqala ukufunda ngemicimbi yezezimali zedijithali, okwakubizwa nge-cryptocurrency. Wathola ukuthi lezi zimali zaziwusizo, futhi abantu abaningi babefuna ukuyisebenzisa ukuthenga imikhiqizo. U-Nokuthula wathola ukuthi, uma engafaka lezi zimali ebhizinisini lakhe, angathola amakhasimende amasha akhuluma ngempela ngalesi sikhathi se-cryptocurrency. Ngesonto elilandelayo, u-Nokuthula wenza izinguquko. Waqala ukwamukela i-Bitcoin njengendlela yokukhokha. Lokhu kwashintsha yonke into. Amakhasimende amaningi afika, ethenga izipho zakhe, futhi abanye baphinde baba sebenzisa lezi zimali ezintsha ezikhangayo. U-Nokuthula wathola ukuthi, ngokwamukela i-cryptocurrency, akonlywa kuphela ukumkhuthaza, kodwa kwavula nesango lokubambisana nezinkampani ezinkulu ezisebenzisa lezi zimali. Ngokuvamile, ibhizinisi lika-Nokuthula laqhubeka nokukhula. Waqonda ukuthi ukuhambisana nezinguquko zesikhathi kubalulekile. U-Nokuthula waphinde waphakamisa umbono wokuthi amabhizinisi amancane angavuma izinguquko, futhi angasebenzisa amathuba aphuma ezimakethe ukuze akhule ekuphileni. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubufakazi bokuthi i-cryptocurrency ingaba usizo emabhizinisini amancane, kwavula umnyango omusha, okwakuhambisana nezifiso zakhe zokwandisa ibhizinisi lakhe.

text: Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo (audiobooks) Umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo, owaziwa nangokuthi ama-audiobooks, ubonisa ukukhula okusheshayo emhlabeni wonke, uhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje nezidingo zabafundi. Le nhloso yokuhlaziya izobheka izinzuzo, izinselelo, kanye nomthelela walolu hlobo lwezincwadi emphakathini. Okokuqala, izincwadi ezilalelwayo zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba bafunde, ikakhulukazi labo abangenayo isikhathi sokufunda izincwadi ezibhalwe phansi. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba lezi zincwadi zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kolwazi, zikhuthaza umqondo wokufunda, futhi zandisa imikhuba yokufunda phakathi kwezizukulwane ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, zenza kube nokwenzeka kwabantu abakhubazekile, ikakhulukazi labo abanezinkinga zokubona, ukufinyelela ezincwadini. Nokho, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ukuze kube nokwamukelwa okuhle, kudingeka izinga eliphezulu lokukhiqiza, okuhlanganisa izwi elihle, ukuhlela kahle, kanye nezithombe ezihambisanayo. Lokhu kudinga izinsiza ezinkulu, okwenza kube nzima kubabhali abancane nabakhiqizi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuncintisana phakathi kwezinkampani ezikhiqiza izincwadi ezilalelwayo kudala umphumela wokwehlisa izindleko, okungaholela ekwehleni kwekhwalithi. Ekugcineni, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ubonisa ukukhula okukhulu, futhi unomthelela omuhle ekufundeni nasekuthuthukiseni ulwazi. Nokho, ukuze uqhubeke nokukhula, abahlinzeki kumele baqinisekise ikhwalithi, baphendule izidingo zabafundi, futhi bahlaziye izinselelo ezikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi izincwadi ezilalelwayo zibe yinsiza ebalulekile emhlabeni wezincwadi.

text: Emadolobheni amancane, uThandi wayejwayele ukuhamba ezitolo zendawo ukuze athenge izinto azidingayo. Nokho, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, waqala ukuqaphela izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wokuthenga. Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-e-commerce kwavela, futhi lokho kwashintsha indlela abantu abathenga ngayo. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wathola isikhangiso se-inthanethi esikhangisa imikhiqizo ethokozisayo. Wazama ukungena ku-inthanethi, wathola ukuthi angathenga konke akudingayo ngaphandle kokuphuma endlini. Lokhu kwamsiza ukuba acabange ukuthi kungani kufanele ahambe ezitolo uma angathola konke kalula ngekhompyutha yakhe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukujwayela ukuthenga ku-inthanethi. Wathola ukuthi izitolo eziningi zendawo zikhona ku-inthanethi, futhi ezinye zazo zikhokhela izindleko zokulethwa. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kakhulu, futhi wathola isikhathi esithe xaxa sokwenza izinto azithandayo. Nokho, akuzange kube lula kuphela. UThandi waqala ukubona ukuthi izitolo zendabuko ziya zincipha, futhi abathengisi bendawo babebhekene nezinkinga. Uthando lwakhe lokuthenga ezitolo lwaluphela kancane kancane, njengoba ebona izitolo eziningi zivalwa. Lokhu kumshiya nomuzwa wokukhathazeka, njengoba ebona umphakathi wakhe ushintsha. Ekugcineni, uThandi wathola ibhalansi. Waqala ukuhamba ezitolo zendabuko ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze axhase abathengisi bendawo, kodwa waqhubeka nokuthenga ku-inthanethi ukuze athole izinto ezithile. Wafunda ukuthi izinguquko emikhubeni yokuthenga zikhona, kodwa kubalulekile ukugcina isiko lokuthenga lendawo. Lokhu kwamsiza ukuba abe nekhono lokuphila phakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu zomhlaba.

text: Izinguquko endleleni abantu abasebenzisa amabhange edijithali ziye zaba mkhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ukuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokwanda kwe-inthanethi, kube nomthelela omkhulu ekutheni amabhange edijithali abe yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu. Abantu baye baqonda ukuthi bangawasebenzisa kanjani amabhange edijithali ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokubhanga. Lokhu kuphumelele ekwenzeni amabhange edijithali athandwa, njengoba abantu befuna ukufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni zabo. U-Nikki Ndaba, umsebenzisi, uveza ukuthi kubalulekile ukuba akwazi ukufinyelela imali yakhe nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, noma ngabe usesikhathini esikude. "Ngisebenzisa i-app yebhange lami, futhi ngiyakwazi ukwenza zonke izinto, kusukela ekudluliseni imali kuze kube ekuphathweni kwezinsiza," kusho uNdaba. Ngokwezibalo, ababhali bezezimali baveza ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwamabhange edijithali kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezindlela zokukhokha eziphephile nezisheshayo. Lokhu kukhuthaze abantu abaningi ukuba bacabangele ukusebenzisa amakhadi okudayisa, okuyindlela entsha yokukhokha ekhuthaza ukuhamba kwemali ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zokuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhange amaningi athuthukise izinsizakalo zawo ukuze ahlinzeke ngemisebenzi eyengeziwe efana nokuhweba ngezimali, ukutshalwa kwezimali, kanye nezinsizakalo zezezimali ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kuholele ekukhuleni kweziqhamo, njengoba abantu benza ezinye izinqumo ezithinta ukuphila kwabo. Nokho, ubuchwepheshe bulethe nezinkinga, okuyinto imakethe yezezimali ezama ukuyilungisa. Nokho, kubonakala ukuthi abantu sebekuthokozela kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwamabhange edijithali, okwenza kube umkhuba ophumelelayo okhula njalo.

text: Ukuhlaziywa kokwanda kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umcimbi obalulekile uzobanjelwa eGoli, lapho kuzobe kuxoxwa khona ngokuqhubekayo kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini. Lo mcimbi, obizwa ngokuthi "I-Industrial Robotics Summit," uzohlanganisa ochwepheshe, abacwaningi, nabathengisi abavela emhlabeni wonke, ukuze bahlaziye izinzuzo nezithiyo ezihambisana nokwandiswa kokusetshenziswa kwama-robot emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Izinkulumo ezibalulekile zizophathwa ngochwepheshe abahamba phambili embonini, bechaza indlela ama-robot athuthukisa ngayo ukukhiqiza, ukunciphisa izindleko, nokwandisa ikhwalithi yomkhiqizo. Kuzoba nezinkomba ezithokozisayo zokuthi ama-robot asiza kanjani ekwenzeni imisebenzi ethile, njengokuhlanganiswa, ukulawulwa kokusebenza, kanye nokupakisha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi uzoba nethuba lokuxhumana, lapho abahlanganyeli bengaxhumana khona, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Izingxoxo ezizokwenziwa zizoqhakambisa izindlela ezintsha zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-robotics, okuhlanganisa nokufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlakaniphile, ezizokwazi ukunciphisa imiphumela emibi yokusebenza kwabantu. Lo mcimbi uzoba yithuba elihle lokuhlola ikusasa le-automation embonini, futhi uzokhuthaza abahlanganyeli ukuba bacabangele izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi yabo. Ngakho-ke, abathintekayo baphakanyiswa ukuba babambe iqhaza futhi bazuze kulolu hlelo oluyingqayizivele.

text: Ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi kubonakala ngokucacile. Lezi zinhlelo ziye zaba yinsiza ebalulekile kubantu abafuna ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo ezilimini ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kokuba zisebenziseka kalula, zikhuthaza ukufunda okuqhubekayo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezilimini eziningi. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-Duolingo, Babbel, ne-Rosetta Stone ziye zaba nemiphumela emihle. I-Duolingo, ngokukhethekile, ibonakala iyinsiza ethandwa kakhulu, ngenxa yokwakheka kwayo okuhehayo nokuhlanganisa imidlalo yokufunda. Lokhu kwenza ukufunda kube mnandi futhi kube lula, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha. I-Babbel, ngakolunye uhlangothi, igxile ekufundeni izilimi ngokusebenzisa izimo zempilo yangempela, okwenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa ulwazi olutholakele nezimo zangempela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokusebenza zikhuthaza ukufunda okuzimele, okuvumela abafundi ukuba baphendule ngezikhathi zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanezikhathi ezinzima zokufunda ezikoleni noma emsebenzini. Ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono, izinhlelo zikhuthaza ukusebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufunda, njengezithombe, ama-video, nezivivinyo. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nalezi zinhlelo. Abanye abantu bangase baphawule ukuthi ukufunda nge-apps akufani nokufunda ngokomuntu, njengoba ukuxhumana nabanye abantu kungase kube kuncane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo eziningi zidinga ukukhokhwa ukuze uthole izici ezithuthukisiwe. Ngokuphetha, ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi kubonisa indlela entsha yokufunda. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baqale uhambo lwabo lokufunda izilimi, futhi zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi olusha. Noma zikhona izinselelo, izinzuzo zikhangayo, futhi zikhombisa ikusasa elikhanyayo lokufunda izilimi.

text: Izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ziye zaba yinsakavukela emhlabeni wanamuhla, zikhombisa umthelela omkhulu ezimfundisweni, ezomnotho, nasezimpilweni zabantu. Kubalulekile ukuhlela ingxoxo-mpikiswano mayelana nemiphumela yokwanda kwalezi zindawo. Okokuqala, izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zandisa amathuba okuxhumana kwabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, abantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukene bangahlangana, bashintshisane ngemicabango, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obusha. Lokhu kwandisa ubuchwepheshe besikhala somsebenzi, okungaholela ekwenzeni imisebenzi emisha. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo ezivela kubantu abahlukene zingavela, kanti lokhu kungenza umphakathi ube nokuhlanganyela kwezinkanyezi eziningi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuhlanganiswa kwabantu ngezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo kungabangela izinkinga. Ukwanda kwezingxoxo eziningi nemibono ehlukeneyo kungadala ukungezwani phakathi kwezisebenzi nezimbonini. Abanye abantu bangase bazizwe behlulekile uma behlanganyela nabanye abanamakhono aphezulu noma ababambisene kumabhizinisi amakhulu. Lokhu kungaholela emishweni yokuncipha kokukhuthazeka nokusebenza kahle. Okokugcina, izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zikhokhela ezindleleni ezintsha zokusebenza. Njengoba abantu behamba phambili, bangathola indlela yokusebenzisa kahle isikhathi sabo, bakwazi ukuhlela imisebenzi yabo ngendlela efanele. Nokho, lokhu kudinga ukuba izindawo zibe nezinsiza ezanele ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusebenza kahle. Ngakho-ke, umthelela wokwanda kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo uhambisana nezinzuzo nezinkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi sihlale sikhumbula lokho okushiwo yindawo yokusebenza ethile futhi sithuthukise imikhuba yethu ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezinkulu.

text: Ekhaya elisemaphandleni, lapho izintaba nezihlahla zikhangisa ubuhle bemvelo, kwaqhamuka umqondo omusha wezokuvakasha. UNomsa, intombazane encane ethokozisayo, yayikholelwa ekutheni umnotho wendawo ungathuthukiswa ngezokuvakasha zasemakhaya. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, wanquma ukuvula indawo yokwamukela izivakashi ezivela emadolobheni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNomsa wakha ibhizinisi elincane lokwamukela izivakashi, elawulwa ngempela ngendaba yendawo. Waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokuvakasha, efaka phakathi ezokuthuthukisa, ukufundisa izivakashi ngemigudu yokuphila kwasemakhaya, kanye nokwabelana ngemisebenzi yokukhonza, efana nezinsizakalo zokupheka ukudla kwasekhaya. Izivakashi zafika, zikhumbula izinsuku zabo ezinhle ezisemakhaya. Zazithokozisa ngezithombe ezinhle, zifunda ngezamasiko, futhi zaba nezinhloso zokuhamba zisebenzisana nezinhlangano zomphakathi. Lokhu kuvuselela umnotho wendawo; abanikazi bamabhizinisi basemakhaya baqala ukuthola imali, izisebenzi zanda, futhi umoya wokubambisana wawusuka phansi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba nempumelelo. UNomsa wabona ukuthi izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zingaholela ekuthuthukisweni komnotho, zixhumanisa abantu, zithuthukise izimboni, futhi ziqinise imiphakathi. Ngamafuphi, waphumelela kakhulu, futhi umphakathi wakhe waba isibonelo esihle sokuthi izokuvakasha zingaba nesandla esikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo.

text: Ingxoxo Ngokuvikelwa Kwedatha Yomuntu Siqu Ezinkundleni Zedijithali Umxoxi: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungimema kulesi sikhathi. Ngifuna ukwazi ngezinto ezihlukahlukene ezithinta ukuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu ezinkundleni zedijithali. Umlingani: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Ngokwami, olunye lwezinselelo ezinkulu zokuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu yikhono lezinhlangano ukukusebenzisa kahle idatha esiyitholayo. Abantu baye bayazisa ukuthi idatha yabo ibalulekile, kodwa abazi kahle ukuthi ihlDBiI ukufinyeleleka. Umxoxi: Yiqiniso, ubani obhekelela ukuvikela le datha? Ingabe izinkampani kufanele zibe nemigomo ecacile? Umlingani: Impela, izinkampani kufanele zibe nemigomo eqinile. Ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi idatha isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, kufanele zinikeze abantu inkululeko yokukhetha – lokho kuhambisana nemigomo ye-GDPR. Nokho, izinkampani eziningi azizithobeli. Umxoxi: Lokhu kubonisa umazisi wesiqondiso. Yimaphi amanye amanxeba ahamba phambili? Umlingani: Ukuze siqonde ukuthi sinokuthile kwedatha, lokhu kudinga ukulandela amahlelo ahlukene, ukuze kwandiswe ukuvikeleka. Izinselelo ezinkulu zihlanganisa ubugebengu bedijithali, lapho amagciwane nezinhlobo ezahlukene zokuhlasela zingadala ukulahleka kwedatha. Umxoxi: Ngabe abantu bangawathola kanjani amathuba okwazi ukuvikela idatha yabo? Umlingani: Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi kufanele basebenzise amaphasiwedi aqinile, baphuthe idatha yabo, futhi baqaphe izicelo zokufinyelela. Ukuze kugcinwe ukuvinjelwa kokuhlasela, kubalulekile ukuthi bahlole izinketho zokuvikela ezifana ne-multi-factor authentication. Umxoxi: Ngiyabonga ngale ngcingo ewusizo. Ukuhlukana phakathi kwedatha, kokubili komuntu siqu nokuhlangenwe nakho, kuyalulekwa ukuze siqhubeke siphila ngokuphepha. Umlingani: Ngiyavuma, okubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ukuze babe nesizotha mayelana nedatha yabo. Kuhlale kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuvikelwa kwedatha akusiyona nje inhloso, kodwa kuwumsebenzi obalulekile.

text: Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla UThabiso Mkhize, ongumlimi odumile eNingizimu Afrika, uthokozisa izitsha zomhlaba ngephrojekthi yakhe yokusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo. UThabiso wazalwa emndenini wemisebenzi yokulima, futhi kususelwa kuleli thuba, waqala ukubona ukuthi izinga lokukhiqiza libalulekile ukuze ahlale phambili embonini yokudla. Ubuye waqaphela ukuthi izindlela zendabuko zokulima zidinga ukuvuselelwa ukuze zikwazi ukuncintisana ezimakethe zanamuhla. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe kwezolimo, uThabiso wanquma ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obusha ebuhleni bakhe. Waqala ukufunda ngama-drone, awafuna ukuwasebenzisa njengensiza yokwengeza ukukhiqiza. Ngama-drone, uthola imifanekiso ephezulu yamasimu akhe, okwenza kube lula ukuhlola izimo zezinhlobo ezahlukene zemvelo neziphuzo. text: Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla Ama-drone asetshenziswa kakhulu kwezolimo ukuze kutholakale izinzuzo eziningi ekulimaneni nasekubhekeni izitshalo. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-drone, okufanele ube sobala mayelana nokuthi uyafuna ukuyisebenzisa ukukala, ukuphonsa imithi, noma ukuskena izindawo. 2. Ukufunda imithetho yendawo: Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa i-drone, kubalulekile ukufunda imithetho esebenzayo endaweni yakho. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izimvume ezidingekayo nokuhlonza izindawo ezithile lapho ukufaka i-drone kungekho ngaphansi kokuvunyelwa. 3. Ukuphatha amathuluzi: Qiniseka ukuthi unayo yonke imishini efanele, njengemishini yokubona (sensors) noma amakhompyutha angakwenza ube nolwazi olunembile lwezimo zezindawo. 4. Ukwenza ucwaningo: Sebenzisa i-drone ukukala futhi uhlole ukukhula kwezitshalo. Ama-drone angakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngempilo yezitshalo, kubandakanya ukukhula, ukwehla kwezinga lamanzi, noma izifo ezithile. 5. Ukuphatha imisebenzi yokudla: Enza imithi enembile, uma kudingeka, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izitshalo zakho zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. I-drone ingezwa imithi ngokujulile kumhlabathi, iyophinde iqiniseke ukuthi kuyahamba kahle. 6. Ukuhlaziya idatha: Ngemuva kokuhlola izindawo, sebenzisa isoftware ezithile ukuze uhlole futhi udale izixazululo ezithile okufanele zisetshenziswe kumapulani akho okulima. 7. Ukuphinda uhlole: Njalo qinisa imiphumela yakho futhi uhlole izinga lemisebenzi yakho. Ukusebenzisa ama-drone kwezolimo akupheli lapho kuphuliwe; kufanele uqhubeke uhlole intuthuko. Ngendlela le, ama-drone angasiza kakhulu ekulimaleni, ukwandisa ukukhiqiza, futhi yenze izinqumo ezinembile. Njengoba izinkanyezi zikhula emkhakheni wezolimo, ama-drone azoba yinsiza ebalulekile kumalimi.

Abantu bangasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene ukuze baqaphe izimali zabo, benze izinkokhelo, futhi bathole izinsiza eziningi ngaphandle kokuphuma emakhaya. Lezi zinguquko zikhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlale bujabulisa, futhi buphinde buphucule impilo yabantu emhlabeni jikelele. text: Kwazulu, emadolobheni nasemaphandleni, umsakazo bekungumthombo omkhulu wolwazi, ukuhlekisa, nokuxhumana. UThandi wathola ukuthi angalalela umsakazo wakhe owawuthandayo noma kuphi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani. Wazithokozisa ngokuqhubeka nokulalela izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ezinjengokuhlola izindaba zakamuva, umculo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxoxa. Kodwa lokhu akukhona kuphela. Abanye abantu, njengomngani wakhe uSipho, baqala ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-smartphone zabo. USipho, owayejwayele ukulalela umsakazo kuphela emakhaya, wathola ukuthi angalalela umsakazo wezwe lonke, ngisho neziteshi ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Lokhu kumenze waba nomuzwa wokuba yingxenye yomhlaba omkhulu. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinkundla zokusakaza zashintsha umqondo wokuthi umsakazo ungumthombo owodwa kuphela. Zaba yindawo yokuxhumana, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezithokozisayo. Abantu bahlala bexoxa ngezinhlelo ababelalele, bejabulela imicabango emisha, futhi bezwakalisa imibono yabo. Ngakho-ke, izinguquko emikhubeni yokulalela umsakazo zikhombisa ukuthi, ngisho noma izindlela zishintsha, umoya wokuxhumana nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu uhlala uqinile. UThandi noSipho bahlala bejabule, bephila impilo enothile, bazi ukuthi umsakazo awupheli, kodwa uthola indlela entsha yokuphila.

text: Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla Ngokukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, ama-drone sekwaba yinsiza ebalulekile emkhakheni wezolimo. Namuhla, abalimi bathola izinzuzo eziningi ngokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza, okwenza kube nokusebenza kahle okukhulu emasimini. Ama-drone asetshenziselwa ukuhlola izitshalo, ukuqapha izifo, kanye nemiphumela yokungena kwamanzi. Lezi zinsiza zikwazi ukuthola ulwazi oluyigugu ngokushesha, lapho abalimi bengathola khona imibiko enembile mayelana nezimo zezimila zabo. Lokhu kusiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezisheshayo zokuvikela izitshalo, okunciphisa ukulahleka kokudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone angasetshenziswa ukwenza ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezifana nezibulali-zinambuzane kanye nezinhlamvu. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezinzima, okwandisa ukukhiqiza kokudla. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-drone kunciphisa umthelela wezemvelo, njengoba kunciphisa izidingo zokusebenzisa izimoto ezinkulu ezidla uphethiloli. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukusebenzisa ama-drone kwezolimo kungaholela ekwandeni kokukhiqizwa, okuthuthukisa umnotho wabalimi. Ngakho-ke, ama-drone awazange abe yinsiza kuphela, kodwa sebecabanga ngempumelelo emhlabeni wezolimo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubonakala sengathi ama-drone azoba nemithelela emikhulu emkhakheni wezolimo ezinsukwini ezizayo.
topic: Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla

text: Yazi, indima yemidlalo yendabuko empilweni yethu ibaluleke kakhulu. Noma sihamba phi, sithola imidlalo ethile edinga ukuba sidlale ndawonye, okwenza kube lula ukudala ubumbano. Ngokuyinhloko, imidlalo yendabuko akuyona nje indlela yokuzijabulisa; iyindlela ethokozisayo yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ucabanga ncamashi, uma umphakathi udlala umdlalo wezok Traditional Dance, bonke abantu bejabula, beqhamuka emakhaya abo, bephuma abangane. Lobo buhlanti, loli suku lunokwandisa ubudlelwano, njengoba abantu bekhuluma, behlekisa, futhi besabelana ngezinkumbulo. Kungabukeka kancane, kodwa lezi zixhumanisi zenza ukuthi sibe nempilo engcono. Futhi akukhona nje ukudlalela, kodwa imidlalo yendabuko ifundisa izifundo ezibalulekile. Iziphakamiso, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana – konke lokhu kuza lapho sithokozisa emidlalweni. Ukubona umphakathi uphakamisa isiko elithile, lokho kudala umqondo wokuzithoba, umdlandla, futhi kubuye kube nomthelela omuhle ezimpilweni zethu. Ngakho, njengoba sithuthukisa imidlalo yendabuko, asithokozisi kuphela, kodwa futhi sihamba phambili ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano. Uhlelo oluphumelelayo lungashiwo njengemidlalo esinse umoya, eyakhayo, futhi ezwakalayo. Ngokuqhubeka nalemidlalo, singaqhubeka sithokozisa futhi sakhe izixhumanisi ezinqala phakathi kwethu. Lokho kuyingxenye yesiko lethu, futhi kuyasiza ekwakheni eminye imidlalo ezayo. Ngabe unayo imidlalo ethile oyithandayo?
topic: Indima yemidlalo yendabuko ekwakheni ubumbano emphakathini

text: Indima yeminyuziyamu ekugcineni umlando namasiko Iminyuziyamu ibalulekile empilweni yethu njengoba ibamba izigigaba zomlando, izinkolelo, nezindlela zokuphila zabantu. Zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, futhi zinezindima ezihlukahlukene ezisetshenziswa ukuze kugcinwe umlando namasiko. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuhlangene nezindlela zokukhumbula izenzakalo ezibalulekile nezingcaphuno zempilo yabantu. Okokuqala, iminyuziyamu iyindawo yokugcina izinto ezibalulekile, kusukela ezincwadini zomlando, izithombe, nezithombe eziyimpumelelo. Lezi zinto ziqinisekisa ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zingafunda ngamasiko nezinkolelo ezazikhona ngaphambili. Ngaphandle kweminyuziyamu, ubungako bomlando bungase buphume, njengoba izikhumbuzo ezisemqoka zingalahleka. Okwesibili, iminyuziyamu zisebenza njengesikhala sokufundisa. Ab visitori, ikakhulukazi abafundi, banethuba lokuhlola futhi bafunde ngomlando wabo, ngezindlela ezithakazelisayo nezingokwenziwa. Lokhu kudala ukuqonda okujulile phakathi kwabavakashi, kuhlanganiswe nemibono ehlukene yokubuka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iminyuziyamu ibamba imicimbi ehlukahlukene, efana nemikhosi, izinkulumo, nezifundo, ezikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana kwezamasiko, lapho abantu benganxusa izinkolelo zabo, bephinde bahloniphe izizinda zabo. Ngaleyo ndlela, iminyuziyamu ayigcini nje ngokugcina umlando, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onolwazi, ophilayo, noshiyayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokuxhasa iminyuziyamu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umlando namasiko ethu agcinwa, akhunjuzwe, futhi anconywe.
topic: Indima yeminyuziyamu ekugcineni umlando namasiko

text: Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wemidlalo ye-eSports entsheni yaseNingizimu Afrika Emhlabeni wamanje, imidlalo ye-eSports isiphenduke isiko elikhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha yaseNingizimu Afrika. Njengomuntu onentshisekelo kule mikhakha, ngithanda ukukhetha izinzuzo eziningi ezivela kule midlalo, kodwa futhi ngikhumbule nezingozi ezihambisana nayo. Okokuqala, eSports inikeza ithuba elikhulu lokuxhumana. Abadlali bangahlangana nabantu abanomqondo ofanayo, baphinde bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile entsheni, njengoba kubasiza ukuba bakhulise amakhono okukhokhela, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umkhiqizo we-eSports uthuthukisa amathuba emisebenzi. Izinkampani nazo zifuna ukuthola abantu abanekhono emikhakheni ehlukene, kusukela kumklamo wezithombe, kuze kube ekuphakamiseni imikhiqizo. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imidlalo ye-eSports ingaholela ezinhlelweni zokuphila ezingalungile. Ukuhlale phansi isikhathi eside nokudlala imidlalo kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo, njengezinkinga zokuhamba, ukukhathala, kanye nezinkinga zengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze abasha ukuba balandele imidlalo, kodwa futhi balandele imikhuba emihle yokuphila. Ngakho-ke, ngifisa ukuthumela umyalezo: imidlalo ye-eSports iyinsiza ebalulekile, kodwa kufanele iqhathwe ngokucophelela. Abazali, othisha, kanye nezinkampani kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe imvelo enempilo yokudlala. Uma sinakekela lokhu, singakwazi ukuvumela imidlalo ye-eSports ukuba ikwazi ukuthuthukisa impilo nempumelelo yentsha yethu.
topic: Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wemidlalo ye-eSports entsheni yaseNingizimu Afrika

text: Ucwaningo ngezindlela abantu abasebenzisa ngazo ama-smartwatch luhlelwe ukuze kuhlolwe izindlela ezahlukene zokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza zobuchwepheshe. Ngalesi sikhathi, abacwaningi bahlangana nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, baphinde bahlola izimo ezihlukene zokuphila ukuze baqonde kahle ukuthi ama-smartwatch asebenza kanjani empilweni yabo yansuku zonke. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo-mpikiswano phakathi kwabathandi be-smartwatch, lapho abanye bekhuluma ngezindlela ezilula zokusebenzisa ama-smartwatch, njengokulandelela izinyathelo, izinga lokuphefumula, nokubala ama-calories. Abanye baphinde bakhombisa ukuthi ama-smartwatch awasiza kanjani ekuphatheni izinhlelo zabo zokusebenza, okuhlanganisa nokubeka izikhumbuzo zokuphila kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ucwaningo luhlanganisa nezifundo ezithokozisayo ezivela kubasebenzisi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, abakhuluma ngempumelelo yokusebenzisa ama-smartwatch ekuphatheni izinkumbulo, ukuxhumana nabangani, kanye nokuhlola izimo zempilo. Lokhu kuhlola kuveza ukuthi ama-smartwatch awasizi kuphela ekwenzeni izinto, kodwa futhi akha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokuhlola izindlela ezahlukene zokusebenzisa ama-smartwatch, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola izinzuzo eziphelele ezivela kulolu hlobo lobuchwepheshe. Ucwaningo luhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile kokuthi ama-smartwatch angaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo empilweni yansuku zonke, futhi lukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo futhi enobuchwepheshe.

text: Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, ama-drone asebenzisa izindlela ezintsha zokuphucula ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo. Izinsuku zanamuhla zibonisa ukuthi ama-drone ayingxenye ebalulekile yokuphathwa kwezolimo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kukhule izitshalo. Ama-drone asetshenziswa kakhulu ekuboniseni izimo zezindawo zokulima. Ngokusebenzisa ama-camera aphezulu, abalimi bangathola izithombe ezicacile zomhlaba wabo, bakwazi ukubona izindawo ezidinga ukunakekelwa ngokushesha. Lokhu kusiza ekutholeni izinkinga ezifana nezifo ezithathelwana ezitshalo, ukungabi namanzi, noma ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone angasiza ekuphakamiseni izinga lokukhiqiza. Abalimi bangasebenzisa ama-drone ukuhlinzeka ngamakhemikhali, amanzi, noma izithako zokudla ezidingekayo ezitshalo, okwenza kube lula futhi kusheshe. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokusebenza, njengoba abalimi bengasadingi ukusebenzisa izindlela ezijwayelekile ezithatha isikhathi eside. Ukwengeza, ama-drone anikeza ithuba lokuhlola izitshalo ngezikhathi ezithile, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinyathelo zokulima. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezinsiza ezidingekayo, okugcina umkhiqizo uphumelele. Ngokubambisana nezobuchwepheshe, ama-drone akhombisa ukuthi angaba yinsiza ebalulekile kwezolimo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kukhule umkhiqizo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ikusasa lezolimo lihlala lishintsha, futhi ama-drone azoba yingxenye ebalulekile yalesi sikhathi esisha.

text: Ukuhlaziywa komthelela kwemidlalo ye-eSports kubantu abasha baseNingizimu Afrika Ingxoxo noNkosinathi Mthethwa, umphakathi wezokudlala eNingizimu Afrika Umbuzo: Sawubona, Nkosinathi. text: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, emhlabeni wedijithali, izingane zathola amathuba amahle okunethezeka, ukufunda, nokuxhumana. Nokho, lezi zikhathi zivalelisa ezithakazelisayo nezizwakalayo zaveza izingozi eziningi. Ukuze kuvikelwe izingane, abaphathi, abafundisi, nabazali baqala ukukhipha izindlela ezahlukene zokuvikela. Emakilasi, ngonyaka ka-2004, kwavulwa imihlangano yezokuphepha kwedijithali ezikoleni. Abafundisi bangenisa izifundo zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele, befundisa izingane ngezingozi ezifana nokuxhumana nezing strangers, ukudlula emugqeni ongemuhle, nokulawula isikhathi sokusebenzisa izinjini zokusesha. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo sokuqala sokwakha ukuqonda kwengane ngokuqhubeka kwalesi sikhathi esisha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngo-2010, izinhlelo zokuvikela eziphephile zavela, ezaziza ezinhlelweni zokusebenza kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza mobile. Kwaba nezinhlelo ezichwepheshe, ezazenzelwe ukuhlola okuqukethwe okungafanele, njengoba kwaba nomphumela omkhulu ekuvikeleni izingane emhlabeni we-inthanethi. Lokhu kwavumela abazali ukuba balawule okuqukethwe okwakufinyelelwa ngabantwana babo ngaphandle kokubakhathaza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuvikelwa kwezingane emhlabeni wedijithali kwaba koko, okubandakanya izikhungo ezifana ne-SAIEV (South African Internet Education and Awareness) nezinye eziningi, ezazithuthukisa amaqhinga okusebenzisana nezinkampani zedijithali, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi kuhloswe ukugcina izingane ziphephile. Namuhla, sikhumbula lezi zinyathelo ezithathiwe, futhi ngendlela yokuvikela okuhle kwezingane, umhlaba wedijithali ushlenza. Lokhu kwaba umphumela wokuhlangana kwemizamo yemiphakathi eminingi, edlulisela izifundo ezibalulekile empilweni yabantu abasha. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, naphezu kwengozi, indlela esiqonde ngayo ukuvikela izingane emhlabeni wedijithali iyinhloko ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
topic: Izindlela zokuvikela izingane emhlabeni wedijithali

text: Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo (ama-audiobooks) Umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo, okwaziwa nangokuthi ama-audiobooks, usuphenduke uhlelo olubalulekile emhlabeni wezincwadi. Kubalulekile ukuhlola lezi zindlela zokufunda ukuze siqonde izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nazo. Kuqala, ama-audiobooks enza ukufunda kube lula futhi kube mnandi. Abantu abaningi bahlala bejolise emisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola isikhathi sokufunda izincwadi ezibhaliwe. Ngakho, ama-audiobooks ahlinzeka ngenketho yokulalela, evumela abantu ukufunda ngaphandle kokuba bahlale bezimele. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu kubantu abaqhubeka nemisebenzi yabo noma abahamba njalo, ngoba bangakwazi ukuhamba beqhubeka nezifundo zabo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ama-audiobooks awanikezi bonke abantu ithuba lokucabanga ngokujulile. Abanye bangase babe nezinkumbulo ezinhle futhi bathole imiqondo ejulile kuphela uma befunda bezimele. Ukuze umqondo uthuthuke, kudinga isikhathi sokucabanga, esingase sithwalwe yimizwa nezincwadi ezibhaliwe, okungaba nzima uma ulalela. Ngakho, lezi zindlela zokufunda zinezingozi nezinzuzo zazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangakhetha ukuhlanganisa zombili izindlela, bebenzisa ama-audiobooks ukuze bathole ulwazi oluthile bese befunda izincwadi ezijulile. Ngakho, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo uyakhula, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sihlolisise kahle ukuze sithole umbono ophumelelayo. Ekugcineni, njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ubonakala uyinsiza ebalulekile, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukufunda ngokwakho nakho kubalulekile.
topic: Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo (audiobooks)

text: Umthelela wezobuciko bedijithali emisebenzini yesimanje Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, ubuciko bedijithali buye baba nomthelela omkhulu emisebenzini yesimanje. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emikhakheni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ubuciko, umculo, nezokuxhumana. Abaculi bamanje sebesebenzisa amathuluzi edijithali ukuze bakhe imisebenzi yabo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kubabukeli abaningi. Uhlelo lwezobuciko bedijithali luhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, izithombe ezidijithali, nezinhlelo zokuhlela umculo. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha kubaculi, njengoba besakwazi ukudala imisebenzi emisha ngaphandle kwezithiyo ezinkulu. UJohn Mthethwa, umculi odumile, uthe: “Ubuciko bedijithali buvule amathuba amaningi. Ngiyakwazi ukufinyelela kubalandeli bami emhlabeni jikelele ngempela.” Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuciko bedijithali buye bukhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwabaculi nabalandeli. Izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe yinsika ebalulekile ekwaziseni imisebenzi, futhi abaculi bangakwazi ukuthola impendulo ngqo kubabukeli babo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubambisana, okwenza ubuciko bube nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Nokho, kukhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nokwanda kobuciko bedijithali. Abaculi badinga ukuqonda kahle izindlela zokuvikela imisebenzi yabo, njengoba ukweba kokuqukethwe sekuyinto evamile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaculi babe neziqu ezithile kwezobuchwepheshe ukuze bakwazi ukuvikela imisebenzi yabo. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, umthelela wezobuciko bedijithali emisebenzini yesimanje ubonakala uqhubeka nokukhula, unikeza amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi ulethe nezinselelo ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ubuciko bedijithali buyeza, futhi umhlaba ubheke phambili ekuboniseni imisebenzi emisha.
topic: Umthelela wezobuciko bedijithali emisebenzini yesimanje

text: Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga Umkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga ubonakala ukhula ngokuqhubekayo emhlabeni jikelele. Le midlalo ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela njengendlela yokuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi njengendlela yokufunda, yokuxhumana, nokuthuthukisa amakhono ahlukahlukene. Amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga ziwusizo ekwakheni amakhono okucabanga, njengokuhlaziya, ukuhlela, nokwenza izinqumo. Imidlalo efana ne-Chess, i-Go, kanye ne-Scrabble, ikhulisa ubuchwepheshe bokucabanga ngokuqinile, ibalula indlela yokubona izinto ezihlukahlukene ezihambelana nezimo ezithile. Lokhu kuhlelwa kwengqondo kukhuthaza abadlali ukuba bacabangele izinyathelo zabo, benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, futhi baphendule ezimeni ezinzima. text: Ukusetshenziswa kwe-blockchain ngaphandle kwezimali zedijithali Ngokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwe-blockchain, abacwaningi nabathuthukisi baphenya izindlela eziningi zokusebenzisa le teknoloji ngaphandle kwemali zedijithali. I-blockchain, eyaziwa kakhulu ngezimali ezifana ne-Bitcoin, isivele yaba yinsiza ewusizo emikhakheni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ezempilo, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuthutha. Omunye wemikhakha ephumelelayo wukuphathwa kwemithombo yezempilo. Izibhedlela zisebenzisa i-blockchain ukugcina amarekhodi wezempilo, okuvumela ukuxhumana okungcono phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kokuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lukhona, luhlala lukhona, futhi lutholakala kalula, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubaguli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-blockchain isetshenziswa ekuphathweni kwezimoto. Izinkampani ezithuthukisa izimoto ezizimele zisebenzisa le teknoloji ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lokuhamba kwemoto luhlonishwa futhi lutholakala kalula. Lokhu kusiza ekugwemeni ubugebengu bokukhwabanisa, njengoba wonke umsebenzisi angabona umlando ophelele wemoto. Ezinye izinkampani zisebenzisa i-blockchain ekuphathweni kwezimali, lapho ibhalwa khona yonke imisebenzi yezezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhweba okungcono. Lokhu kudala ukwethembeka phakathi kwabathengisi, kunciphisa amathuba okukhwabanisa. Ngokubheka lezi zinhlelo, kubonakala ukuthi i-blockchain iyithuluzi elinamandla elingasiza emikhakheni ehlukene, ngaphandle kokuba kuphela izimali zedijithali. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi le teknoloji ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo eziningi, futhi ibonisa ikusasa eliqhakazile lokusetshenziswa kwayo.

text: Ukukhula komkhakha wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo eNingizimu Afrika Esikhathini esingaphambili, imidlalo yamavidiyo yayidume kuphela phakathi kwentsha kanye nabantu abathanda ubuchwepheshe. UThabiso noBongani baveza isithombe esikahle sokuthi, ngekhulu lemidlalade, imidlalo iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokuphila, ukwakha, nokunikeza abantu ithuba lokubona umhlaba ngendlela ehluke kakhulu. text: Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo (audiobooks) UThandiwe Mthethwa ungumculi wezincwadi ezilalelwayo, ogcine impumelelo enkulu emkhakheni wezincwadi. text: Idokhumenti Yenqubomgomo: Ukuhlaziywa Kokwanda Kokusebenza Kwama-Robot Embonini Isingeniso Ngokwanda kwezehlakalo zomhlaba jikelele, ubuchwepheshe bama-robot busebenza njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokukhiqiza. Le dokhumenti ihlose ukuhlaziywa kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini, ukuze kuqondwe kanjani lokhu kukhula kuzothinta umnotho, umkhiqizo, kanye nezisebenzi. Ukuhlaziywa Kokusebenza Kwama-Robot Ukusebenza kwama-robot embonini kukhule kakhulu ezikhathini zakamuva ngenxa yokuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe be-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ne-automation. Lokhu kukhula kube nesandla ekwenzeni imikhiqizo ibe namandla, lwenze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabathengi. Izinzuzo ezibalulekile zifaka phakathi: 1. Izimpendulo Ezisheshayo: Ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo, ama-robot angaguqulwa kalula ukuze ahlangabezane nezimfuneko zemboni. Ukuze sukuqhamuka nezinkinga, kudinga ukusungulwa kwemigomo ethile yokuhlanganisa ama-robot nezisebenzi ezikhona, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukephukele ukuthola imbango phakathi kwamathuba ezintsha nokugcinwa kwemisebenzi. Isiphetho Ukuze iNkampani yethu iqhubeke nokukhula nokuphumelela ngaphansi kwalesi simo, kubalulekile ukuhlinzekela ukusungulwa kwama-policy ajulile ahlanganisa zonke lezi zici. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula phakathi kokusebenza kwama-robot nemisebenzi yabantu, kuqinisekisa impumelelo yangaphakathi nelokhu sisebenzisana nenhlalakahle yomphakathi.

text: Ukusetshenziswa kwe-blockchain ngaphandle kwemali zedijithali Ngokuvamile, uma sikhuluma nge-blockchain, sikhumbula izimakethe zezimali zedijithali ezifana ne-Bitcoin ne-Ethereum. Lokhu kungakhuphula ukwethenjwa phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi, njengoba wonke umuntu engakwazi ukubheka amarekhodi ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokukhwabanisa. Okwesibili, emkhakheni wezempilo, i-blockchain ingagcina ulwazi lweziguli ngendlela ephephile. Lokhu kungavumela odokotela ukuthi bafinyelele kalula kumarekhodi wezempilo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iziguli zingaba nokulawula okukhulu ngolwazi lwazo, ziqinisekise ukuthi kuphela abantu abavunyelwe abangafinyelela kulolo lwazi. Ekugcineni, emkhakheni wezokuthutha, i-blockchain ingasiza ekulandeleni impahla. Lokhu kungavumela izinkampani ukuthi ziqinisekise ukuthi imikhiqizo yazo ifika ngesikhathi, futhi zikwazi ukulandela imithombo yokuhamba kwemikhiqizo. Lokhu kunganciphisa izindleko futhi kuthuthukise ukusebenza kahle. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-blockchain ayikhawulelwe kuphela ezimakethe zezimali. Inezinhlelo eziningi ezithakazelisayo ezizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Njengoba sithuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe le teknoloji futhi siyisebenzise ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zethu.

text: Izindlela zokuvikela izingane emhlabeni wedijithali Emhlabeni wamanje, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, izingane zikhula zihlala emhlabeni wedijithali. Lokhu kuhle, kodwa kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubo eziqinile zokuvikela izingane zethu. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi, uma singanaki, singabeka izingane zethu engcupheni enkulu. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa izingane zethu ngezingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa i-inthanethi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwazi ukuthi akufanele zabelane ngemininingwane yazo siqu, njengegama, ikheli, noma inombolo yocingo. Ukufundisa izingane ukuthi zihlale ziqaphele, kuzobasiza ukuba bazi ukuthi akukhona konke okuvela ku-inthanethi okungokwenyama. Okwesibili, abazali kufanele babe nomthelela oqinile ekusetshenzisweni kwezingane zabo kwezemidlalo zedijithali. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusetha imikhawulo yokuthi zingaki izinsuku noma amahora ezingane zingachitha ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bahlale bephila impilo enempilo, behlukanisa isikhathi sabo phakathi kokudlala, ukufunda, nokuphumula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezinhlelo zokuhlola okuqukethwe okutholakala ku-inthanethi. Abazali bangasebenzisa izinhlelo zokuvikela ezitholakalayo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo azitholi okuqukethwe okungafanele. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bahlale bephephile, futhi bazi ukuthi baphila kanjani emhlabeni wedijithali. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhuthaze izingane zethu ukuba zikhulume nathi uma zikhathazekile noma zithola okuthile okungajabulisi ku-inthanethi. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabazali nezingane kuzokwakha isikhala sokwethembana, okubalulekile ukuze izingane zethu zikwazi ukusibona njengabavikeli bazo. Ngakho-ke, njengomphakathi, kufanele sihlanganyele ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izingane zethu zikhula ziphephile emhlabeni wedijithali. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela, ukuqonda, nokubambisana. Izingane zethu zidinga ukuvikelwa, futhi thina, njengabazali, singaba yizikhali zazo.

text: Umthelela wokwanda kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo (co-working spaces) Ngomhla ka-15 kuNcwaba 2023, sizoba nomcimbi obalulekile ophathelene nomthelela wokwanda kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo. Lo mcimbi uzobanjelwa eNyuvesi yaseThekwini, futhi uzohlanganisa abaculi, osomabhizinisi, nabafundi abavela ezikhungweni ezahlukene. Umgomo wethu uwukuhlola ukuthi izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zishintsha kanjani indlela esisebenza ngayo, zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe, futhi zixhumanisa abantu abanemibono efanayo. Izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ziye zaba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezohwebo, zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Lo mcimbi uzohlinzeka ngendawo yokwabelana ngemicabango, lapho abathintekayo bengakwazi ukwabelana ngamasu, izifundo, nezindlela zokuphumelela. Sizoba nezinkulumo ezivela kubachwepheshe abanolwazi, kanye nezifundo ezithokozisayo ezizogxila ekuthuthukiseni amakhono okusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizoba nezingxoxo ezivulekile, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukubuza imibuzo nokwabelana ngemicabango yabo. Lo mcimbi uzoba yithuba elihle lokwakha ubudlelwano obusha, nokuthola ukuqonda okujulile kokuthi izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zingasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni imisebenzi yethu. Sicela ubhalise kusenesikhathi ukuze uqinisekise indawo yakho. Hamba nathi kulolu hambo lokuhlola umthelela omkhulu wezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo, futhi ube yingxenye yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.

text: Inkampani yaseMkhumbane izama ukuthuthukisa impilo yabalimi bendawo. UThabo, umlimi ophumelele, ubona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bama-drone bungasiza kakhulu kulolu hlelo. Njengoba izivivo ziqala, uthola umDrone owawubhekiswe kumayela, owaziwa ngokuba nekhono lokuhlola izindawo ezinkulu ezivumelana nezolimo. Ngelanga elikhanyayo, uThabo uvula isikhumba se-drone yakhe, ayiqhubekisele phezulu. I-drone iyagijima, ibuka izivini, izitshalo, namafamu. Njengoba ibhalela izithombe ezinhle zokusebenza, uThabo uyakhumbula izinsuku lapho abelokhu ehlola izivini ngenyawo, ethwele umthwalo omkhulu. Ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa, i-drone ibuyela. UThabo uyathokoza lapho ebona ukuthi izithombe zikhombisa izindawo ezinesithwathwa, okukhombisa izindawo ezidinga ukunakekelwa. Lokhu kumenza acabangele izinhlelo zokufaka imithi ethile ukuze avikele izitshalo zakhe. Ngenxa yokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza ezintsha, uThabo uthola umkhiqizo ophakeme, kwathi izivini zakhe zaba yimpumelelo enkulu. Abanye abalimi bembula izithombe zikaThabo, behlola indlela angathuthukisa ngayo imisebenzi yabo. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bama-drone bujolile, buhlangabezana nezidingo zamasiko nezomnotho. Ekugcineni, uThabo waba ngumholi emphakathini wakhe, efundisa abanye abalimi ngokwaziswa okutholakala ngamadrone. Zasiza izivini, zishintsha izimpilo, futhi zathuthukisa umnotho wesifunda. Ngaleso sikhathi, i-drone yaba isikhumbuzo sokuhlakanipha kwezolimo zanamuhla, kwenze uThabo waba umfanekiso wesikhathi esisha sokukhiqiza.

text: Ukukhula Komkhakha Wokuthengisa Online Kubathengisi Abazimele Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukuthengisa online sekuyinto ejwayelekile, futhi lokho kubalulekile kakhulu kubathengisi abazimele. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lesi sikhulu sikhula ngokuqhubekayo ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuziphendukela kwezobuchwepheshe kwenze kube lula ukufinyelela emakethe enkulu ngaphandle kwezithiyo ezinkulu ezandleni, njengokutholakala kwezikhala zokuthengisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abathengi bethu bajwayele ukufaka izimpahla zabo online. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha kubathengisi abazimele, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi bangaphansi kwendawo yabo. Abathengisi basendaweni bangakwazi ukwakha amabhizinisi abo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka okukhulu uma beqhuba izinhlelo zabo zokuthengisa online. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe yisiqephu esibalulekile kulokhu ukukhula. Ngaphakathi kwalezi zinkundla, abathengisi bangakha umphakathi, baphinde baphendule imibuzo, baqondise abathengi, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kudala ukwaziswa okukhulu kubathengi, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuthembela kubathengisi abazimele. Ngokuhambisana nalokho, izinkampani ezikhiqiza izinsiza zokuthengisa online ziqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izindlela zabo, zinikeza abathengisi abaningi amathuluzi afanele ukuze baphumelele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izixazululo zokuphathwa kwezimpahla, izinsizakalo zokuhamba, kanye nezindlela zokukhokha ezilula. Ngakho-ke, ngikholelwa ukuthi ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kumkhankaso womboni wezohwebo wezinsuku zethu. Izinselelo ezithile zikhona, kodwa ngamathuba amaningi, abathengisi abazimele bangathola impumelelo enkulu. Qhubekani niphakamiseni imikhiqizo yenu, nisebenzise lezi zinkundla ukudala umphakathi ofuna ukuzitholela imikhiqizo yakho. Lokhu kuyithemba lokukhula okukhulu, futhi akuyona nje ithuba, kuyiphupho elingaqhutshekiswa.

text: Indima yabasunguli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe (tech startups) emnothweni Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengomgogodla wezinguquko eziningi, futhi abasukuli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe baphinde babe nendima ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi lezi zinkampani, ezivame ukuvela njengemibono emisha, zikhona ukuze zishintshe indlela esiphila ngayo, sikhuluma ngayo, futhi sisebenza ngayo. Okokuqala, abasukuli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe baveza amathuba emisebenzi amasha. Njengoba lezi zinkampani zikhula, zidinga abasebenzi abasha, okukhulisa amathuba emisebenzi ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa umnotho, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bathuthukise amakhono abo, okwenza umphakathi ube namandla. Okwesibili, abasukuli baphinde baveza izixazululo ezintsha ezibhekana nezinkinga ezikhona. Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, lezi zinkampani zikhombisa indlela yokwenza izinto ngendlela engcono, efanele, futhi ephumelelayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni umnotho ube nekhono lokukhula, njengoba izixazululo ezintsha zikhuthaza ukuncintisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abasukuli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe baphinde bahlomula umnotho wendawo. Njengoba beqala izinkampani zabo, baphinde baphakela izinsizakalo ezidingekayo emphakathini, okwenza kube nokukhula kwezomnotho ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze abasukuli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe, sibanikeze ukwesekwa okudingekayo ukuze bakhe izinkampani ezizokwenza umehluko. Umnotho wethu udinga lezi zinguquko, futhi abasukuli bethu bangaba yizikhali ezinamandla ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngaphandle kwabo, umnotho wethu ungase ube nezinselelo ezinzima, kodwa ngokubambisana, singakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo.

text: Indima yemidlalo yendabuko ekwakheni ubumbano emphakathini Imidlalo yendabuko ibalulekile ekwakheni ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi eNingizimu Afrika. Le midlalo ayisiyona indlela yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa ibalulekile ekuqiniseni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umphakathi ophilayo ubonakala ngemidlalo yawo, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlola izinkumbulo nezifundo ezibalulekile. Ngokwesibonelo, imidlalo efana ne-‘indaba’ ibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni isiko, lapho abantu bejabulisa khona futhi bexoxa ngezinkolelo namagugu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, njengoba abathandi bemidlalo behlangana ukuze baphumelele futhi bakhuthazane. Umphakathi ophumelelayo udinga ubumbano, futhi imidlalo yendabuko iyinsika yokwakha leli bumbano. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yendabuko iyasiza ekwakheni ubuhlakani bokuxhumana. Nakuba abantu bahlala ezindaweni ezahlukene, imidlalo ibavumela ukuba bahlale ndawonye, baphinde baxoxe ngezinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abantu baveze imibono yabo, baphinde bakhe izixazululo ezihlanganyelwe. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yendabuko ayisiyona indlela yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni ubumbano emphakathini. Isebenza njengendlela yokuxhumanisa abantu, ibasiza ukuba bahlale bexhumene, futhi ibasiza ukuba baphumelele njengeqembu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le midlalo iphila kubalulekile, ukuze sikwazi ukuvuselela ubumbano nemigomo emihle emphakathini wethu.

text: Indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo Izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuheha izivakashi ezivela kwezinye izindawo ukuze zivakashele imiphakathi yasemakhaya, okwakha amathuba emisebenzi, kuthuthukise izinsizakalo, futhi kuthuthukise umphakathi jikelele. Okokuqala, ukuvakasha kwandisa amathuba emisebenzi. Njengoba izivakashi zifika, kudingeka abasebenzi bezinsizakalo ezahlukene, njengabapheki, abahlinzeki bezokuthutha, nabasizi bezokwelapha. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okuvumela abantu bendawo ukuba bathole imali, baphinde bakhuphule izinga labo lokuphila. Okwesibili, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo. Imiphakathi iyagqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala, izindawo zokudlela, nezitolo ukuze zikwazi ukuheha izivakashi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezinsizakalo ezinhle, ezikhulisa umnotho wendawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvakasha kwandisa ukuqwashisa ngamasiko nemvelo yendawo. Izivakashi zifunda ngamasiko, imisebenzi, nezinsiza zemvelo, okukhuthaza ukuvikelwa kwemvelo kanye nokugcina amasiko. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuhlonipha phakathi kwabavakashi nabantu bendawo. Ekugcineni, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zidalela imiphakathi ithuba lokukhula nokuthuthuka. Ngokuhlanganyela, imiphakathi ingathola izinzuzo ezinkulu, okuholela ekwakheni umnotho oqinile, ophumelelayo, futhi ozinzile. Ngakho-ke, indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile lemiphakathi yasemakhaya.
topic: Indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo

text: Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo Umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo, okwaziwa ngesiNgisi njenge-audiobooks, ubukhula ngokushesha eminyakeni yamuva. Lezi zincwadi zibhaliwe ngendlela yokuthi abantu bangazilalela esikhundleni sokuzifunda, okukhuthaza ukufunda kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abangenasikhathi sokuhlala phansi befunda. Izincwadi ezilalelwayo zitholakala ezinhlelweni eziningi, ezifana ne-Audible, Google Play Books, kanye ne-Apple Books, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izincwadi ezihlukahlukene, kusukela kwezokufunda, izinganekwane, izincwadi zezemfundo, kuya kwezobuciko. Abalaleli bangakhetha phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene, kulula ukuhlela izincwadi ngokwezithakazelo zabo. Ukwanda kokusebenzisa izincwadi ezilalelwayo kudalwe yizizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, zenza kube lula ukufunda ngesikhathi sokuhamba, emsebenzini, noma ngenkathi wenza imisebenzi yasekhaya. Okwesibili, zikhuthaza abantu abasha ukuba bathande ukufunda, njengoba zikhanga kakhulu futhi zikhuluma ngezindaba ezithokozisayo. Okwesithathu, abantu abanezimfanelo zokufunda ezinzima, njengokuphazamiseka kokufunda, bangazuza kakhulu kulolu hlobo lwezincwadi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo uveza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Ukuvuselelwa kokusebenzisa ama-headphones, ama-smartphones, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza kwenza kube lula ukuba abantu bazilalele izincwadi ezilalelwayo noma kuphi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo uyakhula futhi uthuthuka, uhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezintsha nezikhuthazayo zokufunda. Ngakho-ke, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ubalulekile ekukhuthazeni ukufunda, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokufinyelela ezincwadini, okwenza kube yinsiza ebalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla.
topic: Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo (audiobooks)

text: Ukusetshenziswa kwezimali zedijithali (cryptocurrency) emabhizinisini amancane Emhlabeni wamanje, imali zedijithali, noma i-cryptocurrency, ziye zathuthukisa indlela amabhizinisi amancane aphatha ngayo izimali. Lezi zimali zisetshenziswa njengendlela yokukhokha, ukuhweba, nokugcina imali. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi yini i-cryptocurrency nokuthi ingasiza kanjani amabhizinisi amancane. Okokuqala, i-cryptocurrency iyimali ethokozisayo edalwe ngezifundo ezinzima zezezimali nezobuchwepheshe, njengokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-blockchain. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthengiselana kwenziwa ngendlela ephephile futhi engaguquki. Amabhizinisi amancane angazuza kakhulu ekwenzeni izinkokhelo ezikhawulelayo, ngoba akudingeki ukuba abhekane nezindleko eziphezulu zokuhambisa imali ngezindlela zendabuko. Okwesibili, ukusebenzisa i-cryptocurrency kulethe amathuba amasha okwandisa ukufinyelela kumakhasimende. Ngamakhono amaningi okuthenga online, abathengi bangakhetha ukukhokha nge-cryptocurrency, ngobuningi bakhona bukhula. Lokhu kukhuthaza umphakathi omusha wabathengi futhi kuvula iminyango emisha yokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-cryptocurrency iyindlela enhle yokuvikela imali emonakalisweni. Njengoba izimali zedijithali zingazitholi izinguquko ezinkulu njengezinga lemali lendabuko, amabhizinisi amancane angakwazi ukugcina inani lemali yabo. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ezimakethe ezishintshashintshayo. Ekugcineni, amabhizinisi amancane angase afune ukufunda kabanzi ngalezi zimali ukuze akwazi ukuzisebenzisa ngendlela efanelekile. Ukuhlola izinzuzo nokuthi zingakwazi kanjani ukuhlinzeka ngamasu aphumelelayo kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi amabhizinisi azithokozisa kahle ngezimali zedijithali, ethuthukisa ukuncintisana kwawo emakethe.
topic: Ukusetshenziswa kwezimali zedijithali (cryptocurrency) emabhizinisini amancane

text: Ngasekupheleni kukaMsombuluko, uNandi, obhade aged 45, waba nokukhathazeka okwengeziwe. Uqedile ukuphatha izingane zakhe, kodwa umqondo wokuthi kumele aqhubeke nemfundo wawumkhathaza. Ezinyangeni ezedlule, wayebona izikhangiso zezinkundla zokufunda online ezikhuluma ngokuqhubeka nemfundo kubantu abadala. Ngezinye zezinsuku, uNandi wathola umdlandla, wavula ikhompiyutha yakhe, wabhala "ukufunda online" ku-inthanethi. Ngemuva kwalokho, wathola izifundo ezahlukene, kusukela kwezobuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana kuya kwezemfundo. Waqala ukufunda ngekhompyutha, wamangala ukuthi isikhathi sidlulile, engazi ukuthi uqhubekile kangakanani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, wathola umphakathi omuhle, abantu abaninzi ababesebenzisa lezi zinkundla, babezokwesizana, babelana ngezifundo, futhi baphakamisa imicabango emisha. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNandi waqonda ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi umhlaba ungokwenkolo. Kwakuyithuba elisha, futhi uNandi wathola injabulo enkulu kanye nokwaneliseka kokufunda. Ngemva kwezinyanga ezintathu, wathola isitifiketi, waphinde waba nemibono emisha, waba nesibindi sokuthatha izinyathelo ezinkulu empilweni yakhe. Ukufunda online kwaba umthombo wokukhula, kwemfundo, nokuphila okuhle. Ngakho, uNandi waphuma phambili; wayezimisele ukuhamba phambili, umbono omusha, nolwazi olwandisiwe.
topic: Ukusetshenziswa kwezinkundla zokufunda online kubantu abadala

text: Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe be-virtual reality emfundweni Ubuchwepheshe be-virtual reality (VR) buye baba yinsiza ewusizo kakhulu emfundweni, buvumela abafundi ukuba bahlale phakathi kwezimo ezihlukene ezingokoqobo, ngenkathi befundisa izinto ezinzima ngendlela ephusile. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-VR emfundweni kuveza amathuba amasha, kuhlanganise nokubona okwakho okwenziwe ngamehlo, ukuhamba ngokukhululeka ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, kanye nokuhlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokufunda ezijulile. Ngokwesibonelo, emkhakheni wezokwelapha, abafundi bangakwazi ukufunda izinqubo zokwelapha ngokusebenzisa izimo ze-VR, lapho bezoba neqhaza elibucayi ekufundeni. Lokhu kunciphisa amathuba okwenza amaphutha empilweni yangempela, futhi kukhuthaza ukuzethemba. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, emkhakheni wezomlando, abafundi bangavakashela ezindaweni zakudala, bezwe izenzakalo ezibalulekile njengoba zenzeka, okwenza ukufunda kube mnandi futhi kube lula. Nakuba kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, kubalulekile futhi ukuqaphela izinselelo ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwe-VR. Izindleko zokuthenga imishini ye-VR zingaba phezulu, futhi akukhona bonke abafundi abanezinsiza zokufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abafundisi badinga ukuqeqeshwa ukuze basebenzise kahle lezi zinhlelo. Ngokuhlanganisa, ubuchwepheshe be-virtual reality buhlale buhamba phambili emfundweni, buhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile nokuhlangenwe nakho okuhle kwabafundi. Uma izinselelo zixazululwa, i-VR ingaba ithuluzi elikhulu lokukhulisa izinga lokufunda, isiza abafundi ukuba baqonde kangcono izinto ezinzima.

text: Indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo Ngokubona kwami, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokushintsha, abantu badinga ukuphuma emakhaya abo ukuze bahlolisise izindawo ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kudala ithuba elihle lokuthi izindawo zasemakhaya zikhulise umnotho wazo. Izindawo zasemakhaya, ezinomlando ocebile namasiko ahlukahlukene, ziwumthombo omuhle wezokuvakasha. Uma izivakashi zifika, zikhuthaza ukuhweba, zikhuthaza abanikazi bamabhizinisi bendawo, futhi zandisa amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuthuthukisa umnotho, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi oqinile, lapho abantu behlangana futhi babelane ngamasiko nemicabango. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zikhuthaza ukuvikelwa kwemvelo. Izivakashi zifuna ukuzithokozisa ngemvelo, okwenza kube nemizamo eminingi yokugcina izindawo zihlanzekile futhi zihlala zikhangayo. Lokhu kudala isimo esihle sokuthi abantu baziqhenye ngendawo yabo, baphile kahle, futhi bahloniphe imvelo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabantu bendawo basebenzisane ukuze bathuthukise izinhlelo zezokuvakasha. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinsiza, ukuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, nokukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuvakasha ezihambisana nemvelo. Uma sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezinhle, sizokwazi ukuheha izivakashi eziningi, okuzoletha izinzuzo ezinkulu emnothweni wethu. Ngokubambisana, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kwezokuvakasha zasemakhaya, okuzosiza ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo, futhi sithuthukise impilo yabantu bethu. Indima yethu njengabantu bendawo ibalulekile, futhi kufanele sisebenzise leli thuba ukuze sakhe umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo.
topic: Indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo

text: Ukusetshenziswa kwezimali zedijithali (cryptocurrency) emabhizinisini amancane Ngiyaziwa ngokuthi nguSipho Mthembu, umnikazi wephrojekthi encane yokuthengisa izimpahla ezikhethekile eThekwini. Njengomuntu onothando lwezobuchwepheshe, ngithole ithuba lokusebenzisa imali zedijithali ukuze ngithuthukise ibhizinisi lami. Ngonyaka odlule, ngathola ukuthi izimali zedijithali, njenge-Bitcoin ne-Ethereum, zingaba yinsiza enkulu ekwandiseni ukuthengisa kwami. Ngokusebenzisa i-cryptocurrency, ngikwazile ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo yami kubathengi abavela emhlabeni wonke ngaphandle kwezithiyo ezinkulu. Lokhu kwenze kube lula ukuhweba, njengoba izinkokhelo zenzeka ngokushesha futhi ngaphandle kwezindleko eziphezulu ezivamile kumabhange. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthola izinkokhelo ngezimali zedijithali kwandise ukuvikeleka, njengoba izinkokhelo zikhona emkhakheni we-blockchain, okwenza kube nzima ukuhweba ngenkohliso. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngithole ukuthi abathengi bami bahlala bejabule kakhulu uma benikela ngezimali zedijithali. Lokhu kudalile ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwami nabathengi, futhi ngithole ukuthi abanye baphinde babuyela ukuze bathenge futhi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngithole ithuba lokukhulisa ibhizinisi lami, ngithola izinzuzo ezinkulu ezivela ekusebenziseni lezi zimali. Ngokubona impumelelo yami, ngikhuthaza abanye abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane ukuthi bacabangele ukusebenzisa izimali zedijithali. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekwandiseni ibhizinisi, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha nokuhweba okukhululekile. Ngiyazi ukuthi ikusasa lezezimali liseduze, futhi ngizimisele ukuba yingxenye yalo.

text: Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe bokuphrinta be-3D embonini Ukuphrinta kwe-3D sekuyinsiza ebalulekile embonini, njengoba kuvumela ukukhiqizwa kwezinto ezihlukahlukene ngendlela esheshayo nehlelekile. Nansi imiyalelo yokusebenzisa leli thuluzi elisha: 1. Ukukhetha Umkhiqizo: Qala ngokukhetha umkhiqizo ofuna ukuwuphrinta. Lokhu kungaba yizinto ezincane ezifana nezinsiza zokusebenza noma imikhiqizo emikhulu efana nezakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukuthi umkhiqizo unokwakheka okungafaneleka ukuphrinta. 2. Ukudala I-3D Model: Sebenzisa isoftware yokwakha imodeli ye-3D. Ungasebenzisa amathuluzi afana ne-Tinkercad, AutoCAD, noma SolidWorks. Qinisekisa ukuthi imodeli yakho iyahambisana nezidingo zokuphrinta, njengezindleko zokusebenzisa izinto ezithile. 3. Ukulungiselela Ukuphrinta: Ngemuva kokwakha imodeli, sebenzisa isoftware yokulungisa ukuphrinta (slicing software) ukuze uguqule imodeli ibe yifomethi efanele yokuphrinta. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusetha izinga lokushisa, isivinini sokuphrinta, kanye nezinye izilungiselelo. 4. Ukukhetha Okokusebenza: Khetha okokusebenza okufanele ukuphrinta. Izinto ezivame ukusetshenziswa zifaka i-PLA, ABS, noma i-Nylon. Qinisekisa ukuthi okokusebenza okukhethile kuhambisana nezidingo zomkhiqizo wakho. 5. Ukuqala Ukuphrinta: Ngemuva kokulungisa konke, qala ukuphrinta. Bheka izinqubo zokuphrinta ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Qaphela izinkinga ezifana nezithiyo noma ukungahambi kahle kokuphrinta. 6. Ukubuyekeza Umkhiqizo: Ngemuva kokuphrinta, hlola umkhiqizo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uhambisana nezinga elifunwayo. Ungase udinge ukwenza izinguquko ezincane noma ukulungisa. 7. Ukusebenzisa Umkhiqizo: Uma umkhiqizo uhambisana nezidingo, ungawusebenzisa embonini yakho. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufaka kumaphrojekthi, ukuwusebenzisa njengemodeli, noma ukuwuthengisa. Ngalezi zinyathelo, ubuchwepheshe bokuphrinta be-3D bungaba yinsiza ewusizo kakhulu embonini, kukhulisa ukukhiqiza nokwenza kube lula ukwakha izinto ezintsha.

text: Ingxoxo Nengcibi: Umthelela Wokwanda Kwezindawo Zokusebenza Ezihlanganyelwayo Umbuzo: Sawubona, Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha. Ucabanga ukuthi umthelela wezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ubonakala kanjani emnothweni wethu? Impendulo: Sawubona! Ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Ngicabanga ukuthi izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zikhulisa kakhulu umnotho. Zihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukisa ukusebenza kwezimboni ezahlukene, futhi zenza kube lula ukusizana phakathi kwabantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Umbuzo: Ngabe zikhona izinzuzo ezithile ezitholakala kubasebenzi? Impendulo: Yebo, ziningi. Okokuqala, izindawo ezihlanganyelwayo zikhuthaza ubudlelwano. Abasebenzi bangahlangana nabanye abantu, bathole imicabango emisha futhi bakhe amanethiwekhi abawadingayo ukuze baqhubeke bephumelela. Lokhu kwandisa amathuba okuthola amaklayenti nokwakha izixazululo ezintsha. Umbuzo: Kukhona yini nezinselelo ezihambisana nalezi zindawo? Impendulo: Impela, kunezinselelo. Abanye abantu bangase bazizwe bengakhululekile, ikakhulukazi uma bezidinga indawo ethule. Futhi, ukuze uthole ukusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi izindawo zibe nezinqubo ezicacile zokusetshenziswa. Umbuzo: Ngabe uhlela ukukwaziwa ngaphezulu kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo? Impendulo: Yebo, ngiyabheka izindlela zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezinjalo. Lolu hlobo lokusebenza luyathandwa, futhi ukukhulisa imithombo yokuxhumana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kuzoba kubalulekile ukuze sithuthukise imiphumela. Umbuzo: Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngemicabango yakho! Impendulo: Ngiyabonga kakhulu! Ukukhuluma ngalolu daba kuhle kakhulu, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizobona intuthuko enkulu ezindaweni zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo.

text: Izinguquko emikhubeni yokuthenga ngenxa yokukhula kwe-e-commerce Ngokukhula okukhulu kwe-e-commerce, izinguquko ezinkulu zenzeka emikhubeni yokuthenga. Ngaphambi kokuthi kube khona lezi zinkundla zokuthenga eziku-inthanethi, umthengi wayephoqeleka ukuba aphume endlini, afune izitolo, futhi abhekane nezixakaxaka. Kodwa manje, konke sekushintshile. Ngiyavuma, ngithanda ukuhamba ezitolo, kodwa ngiyabona ukuthi e-commerce iletha ubuhle obungakaze bubonakale. Okokuqala, kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo ehlukene. Ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuhamba, ungathenga noma yini kusukela ezitolo ezinkulu kuya kumakhelwane. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanesikhathi esincane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuthenga eziku-inthanethi zikhombisa izibuyekezo ezivela kwabanye abathengi, okwenza kube lula ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Ukuthenga ku-inthanethi kungaholela ekunciphiseni kokuxhumana komuntu siqu. Abantu baphila ezindaweni ezixakile, futhi ukungabi khona kokuhlangana nabanye kungaholela ekudakeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezingozi zokukhwabanisa, futhi abathengi kufanele babe qaphelile uma bethenga. Ngakho-ke, ngicabanga ukuthi, nakuba e-commerce iletha izinzuzo eziningi, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukubaluleka kokuxhumana komuntu siqu. Ukuthenga akufanele kube nje ukuhweba; kufanele kube yinto ethokozisayo, enezinkumbulo ezinhle. Kumele sifunde ukusebenzisa lezi zinkundla zokuthenga ngendlela efanele, ukuze sithole okuhle kakhulu kokubili emhlabeni wokuthenga.

text: Indima yeminyuziyamu ekugcineni umlando namasiko ibalulekile emiphakathini eminingi. Iminyuziyamu iyizikhumbuzo eziphilayo zomlando, lapho izigameko, abantu, nezinto ezibalulekile ziqoqwa khona ukuze zihlale zikhumbuleka. Zihlinzeka ngendawo yokufunda, lapho abantu bengafunda khona ngempilo, amasiko, nezinkolelo zabantu abahlala emhlabeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iminyuziyamu ibalulekile ekugcineni umlando. Ziqoqa izimpahla ezihlobene nezikhathi ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinsiza, izithombe, nemibhalo ebalulekile. Lokhu kuqoqwa kwenza kube lula ukuhamba emuva emlandweni, kubonisa izinguquko ezenzekile emiphakathini nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ngokwesibonelo, iminyuziyamu efana neMnyuziyamu yaseLuvuvhu eNingizimu Afrika ibonisa umlando wezizwe ezahlukene, izinkolelo zazo, nezindlela zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iminyuziyamu ibamba imicimbi ehlukene, efana nezinkulumo, izifundo, nemikhosi, okuvumela abantu ukuba baxhumane futhi babelane ngolwazi. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuhlanganyela, okuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iminyuziyamu ibalulekile ekugcineni amasiko, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela ezizindeni ezincane, lapho amasiko angase aphumele ngaphandle. Ngakho-ke, iminyuziyamu ayigcini nje ngokugcina umlando, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onolwazi, oqondayo, futhi ophilayo. Ziyizikhumbuzo eziphilayo, ezisiza abantu ukuba baziqonde kangcono izimpilo zabo, izimpande zabo, kanye nezinto ezibenza babe yilowo nalowo. Indima yeminyuziyamu ibalulekile, futhi kufanele iqhubeke ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu.

text: Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe be-virtual reality emfundweni Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokwenziwa kweqiniso (virtual reality - VR) emfundweni kudinga izinyathelo ezithile ezilandelwayo ukuze kuzuze abafundi. Nazi izinyathelo ezihamba phambili: 1. Uhlu Lokuqala: Qala ngokuhlela futhi uhlole izinto ezifanele ukufundiswa nge-VR. Lokhu kungafaka izifundo ezifana nezifundo zemvelo, ezobuchwepheshe, noma ezomlando. 2. Ukukhetha Imishini: Thola imishini efanele ye-VR. Lokhu kungaba ukuphathwa kwezikhalazo (headsets) ezifana ne-Oculus Rift noma i-HTC Vive. Qiniseka ukuthi imishini iyatholakala futhi ilungile ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zabafundi. 3. Uhlelo Lokugcina: Dala uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-VR okuqukethwe. Lokhu kufanele kube ukuhlobana nezifundo, okufaka amahlaya, noma ama-module aqukethe izifundo ezithile. Ungasebenzisa amaphakheji ama-VR afanelekile noma uthuthukise eyakho. 4. Ukuhlela Iziqu: Hlela izifundo ukuze zifake isikhathi sokuzijabulisa. Abafundi kufanele bakwazi ukuhamba phakathi nezindawo ze-VR okulungiselelwe okufundisayo, bezilungiselela ukuthi bakhulume nabanye abasebenzisi. 5. Ukuqeqesha Abafundisi: Qeqesha abafundisi ukuze bazi kahle indlela yokusebenzisa i-VR. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umoya wokusebenzisana phakathi kwabafundi nomfundisi. 6. Ukubuyekezwa Kwempumelelo: Ngemuva kokusebenzisa i-VR, hlela ukuhlola ukuphumelela kwethuluzi. Thola umbono kubafundi ukuze uqonde ukuthi izifundo ezifundwa zisebenzile yini. 7. Ukuthuthukisa: Zithathele isikhathi sokuthuthukisa uhlelo lwakho lwe-VR ngemuva kokuhlola. Lungisa izinkinga ezitholakele futhi usungule izindleko ezizothuthukisa isipiliyoni sokufunda. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ubuchwepheshe be-virtual reality bungaba nempumelelo enkulu emfundweni, kukhulisa ukufunda ngokubukwayo futhi kulethe ukuthokozisa.

text: Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umcimbi omkhulu wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga uzobanjwa eGoli, eNingizimu Afrika. Lo mcimbi uhlanganisa abadlali, abathandi, nabakhiqizi bemidlalo, futhi uhlelelwe ukuba ube yindawo yokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokwabelana ngolwazi. Izivakashi zizokwazi ukuhlola imidlalo emisha, zifunde izindlela ezintsha zokudlala, futhi zixoxe nabakhiqizi bemidlalo abavela emhlabeni wonke. Uhlelo luzoba nezifundo ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izifundo zokwakha amabhodi, izifundo zokucabanga, kanye nezinkulumo ezivela kubachwepheshe abanolwazi emkhakheni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzoba nezimbangi ezithokozisayo, lapho abadlali bezokwazi ukujabulisa izithameli ngempumelelo yabo. Umcimbi uzophinde ube nendawo yokudayisa, lapho abathengi bangathenga imidlalo emisha, izinsiza, nezincwadi ezihlobene. Lo mcimbi uyithuba elihle lokuhlangana nabanye abathandi bemidlalo, ukwabelana ngemicabango, nokwakha ubudlelwano obusha. Ngakho-ke, uma ungumthandi wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga, ungaphuthelwa yileli thuba lokuhlola, ukufunda, nokujabulela! Hamba nathi, futhi ube yingxenye yalesi sikhathi esikhethekile!
topic: Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga

text: Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa embonini yezokuthutha Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) busebenza njengomgogodla wezinguquko ezinkulu embonini yezokuthutha. Lokhu kubonakala ngokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwemishini yokufunda, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlakaniphile, kanye nezimoto ezizimele. Ukusebenzisa lezi zindlela, izinkampani zikwazi ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, ukunciphisa izindleko, nokwandisa ukuphepha. Okokuqala, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buvumela izinkampani ukuthi zihlaziye idatha enkulu ukuze ziqonde izitayela zokuhamba. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kwedatha kusiza ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuhamba ezisebenza kahle, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela imizila yezenzakalo. Njengoba izimoto zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlakaniphile, zikwazi ukuhamba ngendlela efanele, zinciphisa isikhathi sokuhamba, futhi zandise ukusebenza kahle. Okwesibili, izimoto ezizimele zisebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa ukuze ziqonde imvelo ezizungezile. Lezi zimoto zisebenzisa ama-sensors ne-algorithms ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba ngaphandle kokungenelela komuntu, okuholela ekwandeni kokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emigwaqweni enokuphazamiseka, lapho izimo zishintsha ngokushesha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buvumela izinkampani zokuthutha ukuthi zithuthukise izinsizakalo zazo. Ngokusebenzisa ama-chatbots nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlakaniphile, amakhasimende angathola usizo olusheshayo nolusebenzayo, okwandisa ukwaneliseka kwabathengi. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kubonakala ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buhamba phambili embonini yezokuthutha, buhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithuthukisa ukusebenza, ukuphepha, nokuhlangenwe nakho kwabathengi. Njengoba le mboni iqhubeka nokukhula, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buzoba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elihlakaniphile nelisebenzayo.

text: Ucwaningo ngokusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizishayelayo emhlabeni Umbuzo 1: Yini imoto ezizishayelayo? Imoto ezizishayelayo, noma i-autonomous vehicle, iyimoto engadingi umshayeli ukuze ihambe. Lezi zimoto zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe, njengezinhlelo ze-sensor, i-AI, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze ziqonde imvelo yazo. Umbuzo 2: Ziyini izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izimoto ezizishayelayo? Izimoto ezizishayelayo zinezinto eziningi ezinhle. Zinciphisa amathuba okuphazamiseka emgwaqweni, zandisa ukuphepha, futhi zinciphisa izingozi. Futhi, zingasiza ekunciphiseni umoya ophumayo, njengoba zisebenza kahle kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezimoto ezishayelayo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinselelo ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizishayelayo? Kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nalezi zimoto. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinkinga zokuphepha, izinkinga zokuxhumana, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho. Abantu baphinde bakhathazeke ngokuqhubeka kokuncintisana emsebenzini, njengoba izimoto ezizishayelayo zingase zishintshe indlela abantu abasebenza ngayo. Umbuzo 4: Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthuthuka kanjani emhlabeni? Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi izimoto ezizishayelayo ziya zanda emhlabeni. Emazweni amaningi, izinhlelo zokuhlola nezokusebenza ziye zathuthukiswa, futhi izinkampani eziningi zisebenza ekwakheni lezi zimoto. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umhlaba ushintsha, futhi imoto ezizishayelayo ingase ibe yisixazululo esisha sokuhamba. Umbuzo 5: Yini ezayo mayelana nezimoto ezizishayelayo? Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, kubonakala sengathi izimoto ezizishayelayo zizoba yingxenye ebalulekile yokuhamba emhlabeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinhlelo ezinhle zokulawula nokuphatha lezi zimoto ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokusebenza kahle.
topic: Ucwaningo ngokusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizishayelayo emhlabeni

text: Hawu, uyabona yini ukuthi ama-drone asetshenziswa kanjani ezolimo? Kuyamangalisa! Ngicabanga ukuthi sesikhuluma ngama-drone isikhathi eside, kodwa manje sebezithola indlela yokusiza abalimi. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu ngoba kunceda abaningi. Okokuqala, ama-drone asiza ekuhloleni izindawo. Uma umalimi efuna ukuqapha izitshalo zakhe, angathola um drone, awuhambise phezulu, bese ebona konke. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi esithathwa ukuhamba ngezinyawo. Futhi, umoya opholile ungase usize ukuhamba phezulu, uthole izithombe ezinhle! Kodwa akukhona nje ukuhlola. Ama-drone angasiza ekulweni nezilokazane. Uma umalimi esebona okungahambi kahle, angasebenzisa ama-drone ukuthumela imithi ethile endaweni ethile. Lokhu kusebenza kahle, ngoba akudingi ukuthi umalimi ahambe yonke indawo. Ubona kanjani ukuthi ama-drone angaba usizo ekulimaleni? Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kodwa uma umalimi enza kahle, angathola umkhiqizo omuhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone angasiza ekuthumeleni izimpahla, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwemikhiqizo. Ngakho, njengoba ubona, ama-drone anenzuzo enkulu ezolimo. Ucabanga ukuthi lokhu kuzoshintsha indlela esikhuluma ngayo ngezolimo esikhathini esizayo? Ngiyabonga!
topic: Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla

text: Ucwaningo Ngokusetshenziswa Kwezimoto Ezizishayelayo Emhlabeni: Iphrofayela kaThandiwe Mthethwa UThandiwe Mthethwa, umcwaningi ophambili kwezobuchwepheshe bezokuthutha, uthakazelela ukuhlela nezinhlelo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Uma eqhubeka nocwaningo lwakhe, ubuthakathaka bezimoto ezizishayelayo, uThandiwe ungumholi emkhakheni wezokuthutha. Wazalelwa eThekwini ngonyaka ka-1990, wakhulela emndenini ogxile ezintweni zobuchwepheshe. UThandiwe wamukela iziqu zeB.Sc. kuM Mechanical Engineering kwiYunivesithi yaseNatal, lapho athola khona ugqozi lokuhlanganyela nezinhlelo zokuthutha ezilula, ezisetshenziswa emhlabeni jikelele. UThandiwe usebenze nezikhungo ezihlonishwa emhlabeni jikelele, efaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni ama-algorithms awusizo okwenza izimoto ezizishayelayo zisebenze kahle. Ucwaningo lwakhe lukhombisa ukuthi lezi zimoto zinganciphisa izingozi zokufika kwezokuthutha, kanti zinciphisa nemithwalo yemfuyo emhlabeni. UThandiwe uyakholwa ukuthi izimoto ezizishayelayo zingaguqula indlela umphakathi uphila ngayo, zikhuthaze ukuzinza kokuthutha, futhi zinciphise umthelela emvelweni. Ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezinkulu nezikhungo zocwaningo, uThandiwe ufuna ukusiza ukuthuthukisa imithetho nezinhlelo zokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizishayelayo. Ubonisa intshiseko yokwakha imiphakathi ehlose ukunciphisa imithwalo emhlabeni futhi ukugcina izinsizakusebenza. Imigomo yakhe ibheke phambili, njengoba eqhubeka nokucwaninga, eshinta umcabango wabo bonke abakhethiwe bezokuthutha. UThandiwe Mthethwa uphinde waba yisibonelo somsebenzi oncomekayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, engumholi ocacile ohamba phambili ezikhathini zanamuhla.
topic: Ucwaningo ngokusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizishayelayo emhlabeni

text: Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa embonini yezokuthutha Q: Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buhlanganisa ini? A: Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (Artificial Intelligence) yindlela yokwenza amakhompyutha noma amadivayisi akwazi ukufinyelela izixazululo ezithile ngokufunda nokuhlaziya idatha. Q: Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa bunjani embonini yezokuthutha? A: Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buvumela ukuphathwa okulula kwezinqubo ezahlukene embonini yezokuthutha, kuhlanganise ukuhlela, ukunakekela, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo. Lokhu kuholela ekwenzeni ngcono ukusebenza, ukunciphisa izindleko, nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Q: Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kubonakala kuphi? A: Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kubonakala kakhulu ezinhlelweni zokuthutha ezizimele, njengezimoto ezizimele ezihamba ngaphandle kokufunda kwejwayelekile. Futhi, kutholakala ezinhlelweni zokuhlela ukuhamba ukuze kuncishiswe isikhathi sokulinda. Q: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa embonini yezokuthutha? A: Izinzuzo zifaka ukuvimbela izingozi emgwaqweni, ukunciphisa umoya ophuma emhathekweni, nokwandisa injabulo yabakhweli. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni isithombe sebhizinisi. Q: Kukhona izinselelo ubuhlakani bokwenziwa obuhlangabezana nazo? A: Yebo, kunezinselelo ezifana nokuphepha kwedatha, ukuqonda kwamasiko ahlukene, nokuxhumana phakathi kwemishini nabantu. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo ezicacile ukuze kuzuze abaphakeli nabathengi. Q: Yini elindelwe esikhathini esizayo ngokuqondene nobuhlakani bokwenziwa embonini yezokuthutha? A: Kulindeleke ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buqhubeke bujula, busebenze ngendlela ehlukahlukene, futhi buhlanganyele nezinguquko embonini yezokuthutha, kuhlanganise nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza, njengokuhlola ukuqoqwa kwedatha ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zezimakethe.
