text: Umthelela wokukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi Ngokwezibalo zakamuva, imakethe yezimoto zikagesi ibonisa ukukhula okukhulu emhlabeni jikelele, okuthinta izimboni eziningi. Ngokwe-International Energy Agency (IEA), ukuthengwa kwezimoto zikagesi kuqhubeka nokukhula, kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka ka-2023, okukhombisa ukwanda okukhulu kokuthandwa kwalezi zimoto. Lokhu kukhula kuveza izinzuzo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ekunciphiseni ukukhishwa kwegesi ye-carbon dioxide. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zokuvikela imvelo, amazwe amaningi asebenzisa izinqubomgomo ezikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezimoto zikagesi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemikhiqizo ye-battery, okwenza kube lula futhi kube nezinzuzo zokukhiqiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi kudala amathuba emisebenzi emisha. Izinkampani ezikhiqiza izimoto zikagesi zidinga abasebenzi abanobuchwepheshe obuphakeme, okuholela ekwandeni kwemfundo nezifundo ezihlobene nale mikhakha. Lokhu kukhuthaza umnotho, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikhiqiza lezi zimoto. Nokho, ukukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi akukhululekile ngokuphelele. Izinkinga ezifana nokuntuleka kwezikhungo zokushaja, izindleko eziphezulu zezimoto, kanye nezinsiza zokukhiqiza ziyaqhubeka nokuba yizithiyo. Abathengi badinga ukuqonda kahle izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa izimoto zikagesi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthelela wokukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi uzoba namandla, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nabathengi basebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zimoto ziba yindlela eqhubekayo yokuhamba.

text: Izindlela zokuvikela izingane emkhakheni wedijithali Ukukhula kwemidiya ye-dijithali kudinga ukuthi abazali bathathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze bavikele izingane zabo. Nansi imihlahlandlela elula yokuphatha lokhu: 1. Thola Usizo Kubazali Abanye: - Bamba izingxoxo nabanye abazali ukuze uthole izeluleko ezisebenzayo. Funda ngezinsiza ezifanele zokuvikela izingane. 2. Faka Izivikelo: - Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokuvikela ezifana nezinhlelo zokuphatha isikhathi sokusebenzisa idivayisi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqapha isikhathi esichithwa izingane emhlabeni wedijithali. 3. Bhala Imigomo Yokusebenzisa: - Hlela imigomo ethile yokuphila online. Nikeza izingane umqondo ocacile wokuthi yini evumelekile nokuthi yini engavumelekile. 4. Yazi Izinsiza Ezinhle: - Thola futhi wabelane ngezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengeziqephu zezingane, ezinomthelela omuhle. Hlela imihlangano yokubuka okuqukethwe online ndawonye ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bazi kahle. 5. Hlala Uxhumene: - Xhumana njalo nezingane zakho mayelana nezifundo abazitholayo. Qonda abantu abasha abakha ubungane nabo online, futhi unikeze izeluleko zokuhlola imishado yokuxhumana. 6. Fundisa Ngobungozi: - Qeqesha izingane zakho ngengozi ezihlobene nokusetshenziswa kwe-inthanethi, njengokudlwengulwa kokuhlonzwa nohlanga lwemiyalezo. 7. Bheka Izithombe Nemiyalezo: - Qhubeka uhlole izithombe nemiyalezo ezithunyelwa ku-inthanethi. Cela izingane zikhulume nawe uma kwenzeka izinto ezingejwayelekile. Ngalezi zinyathelo, ungavikela izingane zakho emhlabeni wedijithali, uqinisekise ukuthi bazibandakanya ngendlela enempilo futhi evikelekile. Qhubeka uhlola izinguquko emhlabeni wedijithali ukuze uqinisekise ukuvikeleka kwezingane zakho ngaso sonke isikhathi.

text: Ukuhlaziywa kokukhula kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini Emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, ukukhula kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini sekuphenduke udaba olubalulekile lokucwaninga. Izinkampani zisebenzisa ama-robot ukuze zithuthukise ukukhiqiza, zinciphise izindleko, futhi zandise ikhwalithi yomkhiqizo, ukuze zifinyelele ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kokusebenza kwama-robot, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphambili. Ngokwezinhlolovo, ama-robot angakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi eminingi ngokushesha nangempumelelo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zamakhasimende. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni isikhathi sokukhiqiza, okuvumela izinkampani ukuthi zikwazi ukuveza imikhiqizo emisha emakethe ngokushesha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-robot angakwazi ukusebenza ezimeni ezinzima lapho abantu bengakwazi khona, ngaleyo ndlela kuncishiswe ubungozi kubantu emsebenzini. Nokho, ukwanda kokusebenza kwama-robot akugxilanga kuphela emisebenzini ethile. Ukufakwa kobuchwepheshe bokufunda ngomshini (machine learning) kanye ne-AI (Artificial Intelligence) kukhombisa amathuba amasha. Lokhu kukhuthaza ama-robot ukuba azifundele futhi akhulise ukusebenza kwawo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngokuhamba kwegumbi, ukutshalwa kwezimali ezinkulu ekuthuthukiseni ama-robot kuzothuthukisa kakhulu ukusebenza kwemboni. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokuhlola lezi zinguquko ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ngakho-ke, ukukhula kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini akusikho kuphela ukunciphisa izindleko, kodwa futhi kuholela ekwandeni kokuncintisana emakethe, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho jikelele. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kucacile ukuthi ama-robot azoba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa lezemboni.
topic: Ukuhlaziywa kokwanda kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini

text: Izinguquko emikhubeni yokulalela umsakazo ngenxa yezinkundla zokusakaza Namuhla, umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu emikhubeni yokulalela umsakazo, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokwanda kwezinkundla zokusakaza ezikwi-inthanethi. Lokhu kuvele kuholele ekutheni abantu baphendule ngendlela ehlukile emlandweni wokulalela umsakazo. Ngaphambi kokuthi izinkundla zokusakaza ziqale, abathandi bomsakazo babephinde bahlale phansi bezilalele eziteshini ezithile, kodwa manje, izinto sezishintshile. Izinkundla ezifana neSpotify, Apple Music, kanye neYouTube Music zifeze ukuguqula indlela abantu abathola ngayo umsakazo. Lokhu kukhuthaze abathandi bomsakazo ukuba bakhethe izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezitholakala kalula, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi baphila emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu bangakwazi ukulalela umsakazo noma nini, noma kuphi, kusuka kumakhalekhukhwini abo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ezinhlelweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokusakaza zikhuthaza abaculi ukuba baphumelele, njengoba benikeza ithuba lokufinyelela izithameli ezinkulu. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abaculi nabalaleli behlanganyela imicabango nezifiso zabo. Izinguquko ezinjalo zishintsha umqondo wokusakaza, zenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili kwezobuciko nokuxhumana. Ngakho-ke, izinguquko emikhubeni yokulalela umsakazo zikhombisa ukuthi umhlaba usuhamba phambili, futhi izinkundla zokusakaza zidlala indima enkulu ekuqondiseni lezi zinguquko, ziqinisekisa ukuthi umsakazo uyahlala ubukhali, ufinyelela izithameli eziningi, futhi uhlala ungowesimanje.

text: Ukukhula komkhakha wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo eNingizimu Afrika kuxhumene kakhulu nokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, izinguquko zamasiko, kanye nezinselelo ezithile. Ngemuva kweminyaka yama-1990, umkhakha wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo waqala ukuzwakala, kodwa wathuthukiswa kakhulu ngemuva kokwethulwa kwemishini yokudlala ye-inthanethi kanye ne-computer. Ngalesi sikhathi, imidlalo yamavidiyo yayivame ukuvela ezinkampanini ezinkulu eziphuma phesheya, kanti abantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika babengenakho ukufinyelela kulokhu. Nokho, ngo-1999, kwenzeka umcimbi obalulekile lapho umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika wavulwa emakethe ye-video game, okwakuhlanganisa ukusungulwa kwe-PlayStation. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwezinto eziningi, kuhlanganise nokusungulwa kwezinkampani ezincane ezikhiqiza imidlalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, phakathi kweminyaka yama-2000, abadlali baqala ukusebenzisa izinsiza ze-inthanethi ezifana nama-forums nezinkundla zokuxhumana, okwandisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abathanda imidlalo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwande kokukhiqizwa kwemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kwakha umqondo wokuthokozisa udlalayo. Namuhla, umkhakha wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo eNingizimu Afrika ubonisa uthando olukhulu, futhi uqhubeka uzama ukuthuthukisa izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Abadlali basadlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubuntu, futhi izinkampani zifunda ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze zifeze izidingo zabathandi bemidlalo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umkhakha uzokhula kakhulu eminyakeni ezayo, ubeka eNingizimu Afrika endaweni ebalulekile emkhakheni wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo.

text: Ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi kuyinto ebalulekile emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe kulezi zinsuku. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-Duolingo, Babbel, ne-Rosetta Stone zishintshe indlela abantu abafunda ngayo izilimi. Nokho, lesi sikhula sihamba nezinkinga ezidinga ukugxilwe kuzo. Ngempela, izinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi zenza ukufunda kube lula, kube nephumelelayo, futhi kube mnandi. Zihlinzeka ngezifundo ezihlanganisa ukuphindaphinda, ukuhlela, nokuqhathanisa, okwenza abafundi bakwazi ukufunda izilimi ezintsha noma baqinise ulwazi lwabo ngempumelelo. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kulabo abaphila izimpilo ezinzima, abangenamathuba okuxhumana, noma abathanda ukufunda izilimi emakhaya. Kodwa-ke, kukhona impikiswano ethile mayelana nokwenzeka kwalezi zinhlelo. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi zikhawulelwe uma kuziwa ekuxhumaneni nomphakathi. Isibonelo, ukufunda isiNgisi kudinga ukuxhumana ngqo ukuze uqinisekise ikhono lokukhuluma kahle. Ukuze lokhu kuzuze, abafundi badinga ukuhlangana nabantu abakhuluma kahle izilimi, okungatholakali kalula ezinhlelweni zokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuqaphela izikhala zobuchwepheshe ezisemkhakheni wezemfundo. Abafundi abangenayo inthanethi bangase bazizwe bengaphumeleli ekufundeni kahle izilimi abahlela ukuzifunda. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ekugcineni, ukuphucula izinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi kudinga ukugxila emithini yokuhlangenwe nakho kwabafundi, kanti kufanele kube nomqondo ohlanganyelwe nezifiso zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukufunda izilimi kube lula futhi kujabulise, futhi kuzothuthukisa amathuba okukhuluma ngempumelelo.

text: Ukusetshenziswa Kwezimali Zedijithali Emabhizinisini Amancane Isingeniso Emkhakheni wezamabhizinisi, izimali zedijithali (cryptocurrency) zikhule zaba yinsiza eyingqayizivele, ikakhulukazi kumabhizinisi amancane. Lezi zimali zikhulisa amathuba okwandisa inzuzo, ukuhweba, nokwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Lokhu kukhuphula izinga lokuncintisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi amancane, kunciphisa izindleko, futhi kwandisa ukufinyelela kumakhasimende. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa Izimali Zedijithali 1. Izindleko Zokuhweba Eziphansi: Izimali zedijithali zinciphisa izindleko zokuhweba, njengoba zingadingi izikhungo ezinkulu zezimali. Lokhu kubalulekile kumabhizinisi amancane afuna ukunciphisa izindleko zawo. 2. Ukufinyelela Emakethe Yamazwe Ngamazwe: Izimali zedijithali zenza kube lula kumabhizinisi amancane ukufinyelela emakethe yomhlaba. Lokhu kuvumela abanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuba bathole amakhasimende avela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwandisa amathuba okukhula. 3. Ukuphepha Nokuthembeka: I-blockchain, okuyisisekelo se-cryptocurrency, inikeza ukuvikeleka okuphezulu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukudluliswa kwemali kuphephile futhi kuqinisekisiwe, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba. Izithiyo Ezingase Zibe Khona Nokho, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene namabhizinisi amancane uma efuna ukusebenzisa izimali zedijithali. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukungaqondi kahle kwezimali zedijithali, izinkinga zokuhweba, kanye nemithetho ehlukahlukene ezweni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi baqonde kahle lezi zinkinga ukuze bakwazi ukuzixazulula. Isiphetho Ukusetshenziswa kwezimali zedijithali kumabhizinisi amancane kunikeza amathuba amakhulu okukhula nokuphumelela. Ngokuhlola izinzuzo kanye nezithiyo, abanikazi bamabhizinisi bangathuthukisa izinqubo zabo zokuhweba, baphumelele emhlabeni wezomnotho. Ukufunda nokuhlola izimali zedijithali kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.

text: Umthelela Wokwanda Kwezindawo Zokusebenza EziHlanganyelwayo (Co-Working Spaces) Isingeniso Eminyakeni yamuva, izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ziye zaqhubekela phambili kakhulu, zikhanga abantu abaningi abafuna indawo yokusebenza engabizi, ethokomele futhi enobudlelwano. Lezi zindawo azigcini nje ngokuba izindawo zokusebenza, kodwa ziba yizikhala zokuxhumana, zokubambisana, nezokwakha ubudlelwano. Umthelela Emnothweni Ukuvela kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo kukhuthaze ukuhweba nokwandiswa kwamabhizinisi amancane. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, kuthuthukisa imikhiqizo, futhi kukhuthaza ukusungulwa kwezixazululo ezintsha. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi ohwebo abasha, bathola ukuthi izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zibavumela ukuba basebenzisane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi baphucule izinga labo lokusebenza. Umthelela Kwezokuxhumana Izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ziqinisa imikhakha yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala inethiwekhi enkulu yabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okuvumela ukubambisana kwezobuchwepheshe nezimboni ezahlukene. Ngakho-ke, izinkampani ziba nekhono lokuthola izixazululo ezingcono, kwanda ukuxhumana phakathi kwazo. Umthelela Kwezempilo Yengqondo Ngaphezu kwezinzuzo zomnotho, izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zikhuthaza impilo yengqondo engcono. Ukusebenza endaweni enabantu abaningi kudala umuzwa wokuxhumana, okwakha umoya omuhle wokusebenza. Lokhu kunciphisa imiphumela emibi yokusebenza wedwa, njengokukhathazeka nokudangala. Isiphetho Ngokwanda kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo, kuvela amathuba amasha emnothweni, kuthuthukiswa ubudlelwano, nokuphuculwa kwempilo yengqondo. Ukuze sizuze kokubili kumphakathi nasemphakathini, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhala esisha, esinobungane, nesikhuthazayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile labantu bonke.

text: Indima yabasunguli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe (tech startups) emnothweni Eminyakeni edlule, amabhizinisi obuchwepheshe aphume phambili njengamafasitela amasha emnothweni, ethuthukisa izindlela zethu zokuphila, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokusebenza. Njengomuntu ophila kulesi sikhathi esigcwele ubuchwepheshe, ngikholelwa ukuthi abasunguli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe banezifundo eziningi ezibalulekile emnothweni wethu. Okokuqala, lezi zinkampani zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo, okwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kuphakathi kwezinga lemisebenzi lasekhaya, njengoba abantu abaningi beza nezixazululo ezintsha, beholela ekwandeni kwamathuba kubantu abaningi. Isibonelo, amabhizinisi afana nehlelo lokusebenza lokuhamba, awekho omkhulu uma kuziwa ekwandiseni ukuthengiswa kwempahla nezinsizakalo. Okwesibili, abasunguli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe banesibopho sokwakha umnotho owenziwe ngamasu amasha. Njengoba beqala amabhizinisi, bakhulisa impumelelo emnothweni, nciphisa umnotho wezomhlaba, futhi bathuthukisa ukuphishekela izixazululo ezintsha. Lokhu kuholela ezindleleni ezifanele zokunciphisa imiphumela emibi, okwenza umnotho wethu unothe kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukunikela kwabo kubantu abangasebenzi ngokusemthethweni, kuveza ukuthi amalungu omphakathi angaba nemiphumela emihle ezinkampanini zabo, ukwakha isimo sokubambisana ngendlela eyakhayo. Kanti lokhu kudala umoya wokusebenza nalabo abasha, okwandisa ikhono lezakhamuzi ukujabulisa imiphakathi yethu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sixhase futhi sikhuthaze abasunguli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe. Njengoba besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, basungula amathuba amasha, futhi bakha umphakathi onempilo, siyakuthokozisa ukuhamba phambili emnothweni. Sihlanganyela kulolu hambo lokubambisana, futhi tilele ubuchwepheshe ngoba bukhona ukuzayo.

text: Ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi Ngiyaziwa ngoSipho Mthembu, umfundisi wezilimi oneminyaka engu-10 yokuhlangenwe nakho. Ngikhule emndenini owawukhuthaza ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene, okwenza ngaba nomdlandla wokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokufunda. Ngonyaka ka-2015, ngathola ithuba lokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi, futhi lokhu kwashintsha impilo yami. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngiqaphele ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifana ne-Duolingo, Babbel, kanye ne-Memrise zikhula ngokushesha. Lezi zinhlelo zenza ukufunda kube mnandi futhi kube lula, zisebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene ezifana nemidlalo, izivivinyo, nezifundo ezimfushane. Lokhu kwenza abafundi bakwazi ukufunda izilimi ezintsha noma ngabe bahlala kuphi, ngisho nasemsebenzini. Ngiyavuma ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baqale ukufunda izilimi, ikakhulukazi abasha. Ngithokozisa kakhulu ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zenza ukufunda kube yinto ethokozisayo, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke bezama. Ngiyabonga ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi zikhona, ngoba zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi olusha, futhi zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ngiyazi ukuthi ikusasa lokufunda izilimi lizoba lihle kakhulu, futhi ngiyajabula ukuba yingxenye yalo mkhankaso.
topic: Ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi

text: Izinselelo zokuvikeleka kwedatha yomuntu siqu ezinkundleni zedijithali Njengoba izinkundla zedijithali zikhula, izinselelo zokuvikela idatha yomuntu siqu zikhula nazo. Abasebenzisi bezinkundla zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezikwi-inthanethi bahlala behlangabezana nokudideka phakathi kokufuna ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kanye nezingozi zokulahlekelwa ngemininingwane yabo. NgokweZikhangiso zedijithali, abanikazi bezinkundla badinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bahlola abalaleli babo ngezindlela zokuvikela idatha. Lokhu kuhilela ukusungula izinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela, ezihlanganisa izinsiza zokuvikela eziphumelelayo nezokuthola izinkinga. Nokho, imbangela yokukhathazeka iqhubeka ifihliwe, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngamathuluzi obuchwepheshe. Ucwaningo lwezokuphepha kwedatha, uNkk. Thandiwe Mkhize, uphawule ukuthi: "Izinkundla eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela zokuvikela, kodwa abanye abasebenzisi abazi kahle ukuthi kufanele baphathe kanjani imininingwane yabo." Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abanye abantu basaqhubeka nokwabelana ngezimfihlo zabo, bephonsa inselelo ezinkampanini ezikhangisa ukuvikeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvikeleka kwedatha kudinga izinqubomgomo ezithathelwa phezulu, kodwa akusikho konke okungokwesikhathi eside. Uma abathengi bengazi kahle izinqubo zokuvikela, bangase bahluleke ukugcina imininingwane yabo, okuholela ekulahlekelweni okukhulu kokwaziswa komuntu siqu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi baqonde izingozi ezihambisana nezinkundla zedijithali ukuze bavikele imininingwane yabo. Ukuze kuqhubeke phambili, kudingeka ukubambisana phakathi kwabathengi, abanikazi bezinkundla, kanye nohulumeni ukuze kudalwe indawo ephephile yokuxhumana.
topic: Izinselelo zokuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu ezinkundleni zedijithali

text: Ngesikhathi esithile, uSipho wayehlala edolobheni elincane, lapho abantu babebonana khona bexoxa ngolimi lwabo lwesintu. Nokho, uSipho wayenombono omkhulu: wayefisa ukufunda izilimi eziningi ukuze akwazi ukuhamba emhlabeni. Kodwa, wayebhekene nezithiyo zokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokufunda. Omunye usuku, uSipho wathola uhlelo lokusebenza olusha lokufunda izilimi. Lolu hlelo lwakha izifundo ezahlukahlukene, luhlanganisa imidlalo, izivivinyo, nezifundo ezithokozisayo. Waqala ukusebenzisa leli hlelo nsuku zonke, futhi ngokushesha waqaphela ukuthi ukufunda izilimi akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyajabulisa futhi kuyakhuthaza. Njengoba edlula ezifundweni, uSipho waqala ukufunda isiNgisi, isiFulentshi, nesiJalimane. Uhlelo lwalunikeza ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye abafundi emhlabeni jikelele, okwenza uSipho azizwe engakaze abone. Waqala ukuxoxa nabantu abavela emazweni ahlukene, efunda ngamasiko abo, izindlela zabo zokuphila, nezinkolelo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waba nekhono lokukhuluma izilimi eziningi, futhi lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha empilweni yakhe. Waqala ukuhamba, efunda izilimi ezithile ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi wathola abangane abaningi. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwamfundisa ukuthi ukufunda izilimi akugcini nje ngokufunda amagama, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana nabantu, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokuhlonipha amasiko ahlukene. U-Sipho wathola ukuthi ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi akukhona nje ukwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umhlaba onobudlelwano obukhulu, lapho abantu bexhumana khona ngaphandle kwemingcele yolimi. Lokhu kwashintsha impilo yakhe, futhi waba isibonelo sokuthi ukufunda izilimi kungaba yindlela yokuphila enothando.

text: Ucwaningo ngokusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizishayelayo emhlabeni luqala eminyakeni engama-20 edlule, lapho ubuchwepheshe obusha buqala ukuthuthuka. Ngalesi sikhathi, izimoto ezizishayelayo, noma ezaziwa ngesiNgisi njenge-‘self-driving cars,’ zathathwa njengephupho elikude, kodwa isayensi yaba nesandla kulokhu. Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-2000, inhlangano yeGoogle yathola ithuba lokuhlola umqondo wezithuthi ezizishayelayo. Lezi zinto zokuqala, ezifana ne-Google Self-Driving Car Project, zathola impendulo ethokozisayo emphakathini. Izinjini ezihlakaniphile, izinzwa ezisezingeni eliphezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-software zenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izimoto ziqhube zodwa, ziphephile, futhi zigcine isikhathi sokuhamba. Ngo-2016, izimoto ezizishayelayo zathola ukuthandwa okukhulu, kwavela izinkampani eziningi ezifuna ukungena kulesi sikhala. I-automotive industry yaguquka kakhulu njengoba izinkampani ezinkulu, ezifana ne-Tesla, Ford, ne-Uber, zifaka imali enkulu ocwaningweni nasekuthuthukiseni izimoto ezizishayelayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nokuphepha, imithetho, kanye nemithelela emphakathini. Naphezu kwezinselelo eziningi, njengezokuphepha nokuxhumana phakathi kwezithuthi, umhlaba uqhubeka nokubona intuthuko enkulu. Ngo-2023, izimoto ezizishayelayo zikhona emadolobheni amaningi, futhi abantu baziwa ngokukhetha lezi zindlela zokuhamba ezikhululekile. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi izimoto ezizishayelayo zinganciphisa ukungcoliswa komoya futhi zithuthukise ukuphepha kwezimoto. Ngakho-ke, umnotho wezithuthi ubukeka uyashintsha, futhi isifiso sokuphila ngendlela engcono sikhula. Umqondo wezithuthi ezizishayelayo ususisusa emaphusheni, ube yimpilo yanamuhla, ubonisa indlela esihamba phambili ngayo emhlabeni wesimanje.
topic: Ucwaningo ngokusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizishayelayo emhlabeni

text: Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezinkundleni zedijithali Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izilimi zomdabu zibe yingxenye ebalulekile ezinkundleni zedijithali, njengoba abantu abaningi bezisebenzisa ukuze baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bathuthukise ubuhlakani bazo. Ukuhlaziywa kwenziwa ukuze kubonakale indlela ezilimi zomdabu ezisebenza ngayo ezinkundleni ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ama-blog, nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ucwaningo lwakamuva lubonisa ukukhula kokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezifana nesiZulu, isiXhosa, nesiSwati ezinkundleni zedijithali. Lokhu kubonakala ngokwanda kokubhalwa kwemiyalezo, izinkulumo, kanye nezindaba ezibhaliwe ngalezi zilimi. Abantu abaningi baphendukela ezilimini zabo zomdabu ukuze bazwakalise imizwa yabo, okwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ziyaqaphela ukubaluleka kokuhlinzeka ngama-interface nezinsizakalo ezisebenzisa izilimi zomdabu, okukhulisa ukufinyelela kwabantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangakhulumi isiNgisi kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ekugcineni isiko nezilimi zomdabu, njengoba zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila izilimi zabo. Nokho, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nezilimi zomdabu ezinkundleni zedijithali. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezikhethekile, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo zokufunda ezisekela lezi zilimi kungathinta ukukhula kwazo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinkampani zisebenzisane ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izilimi zomdabu zihlala zikhona futhi zisebenza ezinkundleni zedijithali. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezinkundleni zedijithali kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekugcineni isiko, ukuxhumana, kanye nokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izilimi zomdabu azikupheli, kodwa ziyaqhubeka nokukhula nokuthuthuka.

text: Indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo ibaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wethu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokuthuthuka kwezomnotho, izindawo zasemakhaya ziye zaba yizikhungo ezibalulekile zokuvakasha, okwenza kube nokukhula okukhulu emiphakathini. Ekuqaleni, izindawo zasemakhaya zazithathwa njengendawo yokuphumula, lapho abantu behamba khona ukuze baphumule futhi bajabulele ubuhle bemvelo. Nokho, ngesikhathi sokukhula komnotho, abavakashi baqala ukuza ezindaweni ezinjalo ukuze bahlolisise isiko, imikhuba, nezindawo zomlando. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuvakasha, ezifana nezindawo zokuhlala, izindawo zokudlela, nezinhlelo zokuhamba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zaba yinsiza ebalulekile yokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Abantu bendawo baqala ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezokuvakasha, okuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini, njengoba abantu bekwazi ukuthola imali yokuphila, futhi izindawo eziningi zathola ukuxhaswa kwezimali ukuze zithuthukise izinsiza zazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zandise umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bendawo. Abantu baqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokwazisa izivakashi ngamasiko nezinkolelo zendawo, okwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezivakashi nabantu bendawo. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela ekwakheni isimo sokuthula nokuqonda phakathi kwezakhamuzi. Ngakho-ke, indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo ibalulekile, ngoba ayigcini nje ngokuthuthukisa umnotho, kodwa futhi ikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi izokuvakasha akusikho kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo.

text: Ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, uThandi, ongumthengisi ozimele emzaneni wakhe, wayezizwa edangele. Wayesebenza kanzima ekuthengiseni izingubo zakhe kodwa ukukhula kwezimakethe zokuthengisa online kwenza abanye bethola izinzuzo ezinkulu, kanti yena ethola kuphela abathengi abambalwa. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noSipho, owayesebenza emkhakheni wezokuthengisa online. USipho wakhuluma ngendlela athole ngayo abathengi abaningi ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana nezinye izinhlelo. UThandi wathola lokho kusemqondweni futhi wanquma ukuzama lokho. Wavula ikhasi elisha lokuthengisa online, waba nokholo olukhulu. Waqala ukuhlola izinkundla zokuxhumana, wabelana ngezithombe ezinhle zezinto azithengisayo, futhi wagcizelela ubuciko bayo. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, waqala ukukholwa ukuthi uzophumelela. Ngenxa yomsebenzi ongenasici, abathengi baqala ukuvela. Ngemuva kwesonto, uThandi wathola imiyalo eminingi, futhi izibuyekezo ezinhle zakhula. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, kwavela amakhasimende amaningi. UThandi wathola ukuthi ukuthengisa online kudinga kuphela ubuchwepheshe obufanele nokuzinikela. Emva kwezinyanga eziyi-3, uThandi waba nomuzwa ohlanzekile. Wahamba phambili, wathola abathelisi, futhi uqhubekile nokwandisa ibhizinisi lakhe. Ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kwasiza uThandi ukuba abone impumelelo engakaze icaciswe, waphinde waba yisibonelo kubanye abathengisi abazimele. UThandi wafunda ukuthi, ngezinyathelo ezincane, ngebhizinisi lakhe labe lihamba phambili, futhi ithalente lakhe lathola indawo yokukhula.

text: Ukwaziswa nge-blockchain, ikakhulukazi njengobuchwepheshe obusekelwa kwi-cryptocurrency, sekuphele iminyaka yokuphila kwayo, sazi kahle ukuthi yayiqale kanjani njengesixazululo sokugcina izimali zedijithali. Nokho, ukusetshenziswa kwayo kudlule kakhulu kule ndawo, kube nezinqumo eziningi ezizwakala phansi kwezimali. Ngemuva kokwaziswa kwayo, abantu abaningi baqonda ukuthi i-blockchain ingasetshenziswa kwezinye izindawo, njengoba igcina amarekhodi anembile futhi anokwethenjelwa. Kusukela ngo-2015, izinkampani eziningi ziqalile ukukhipha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezichitha i-blockchain ukuze zilungise izinkinga ezivamile. Isibonelo, emkhakheni wezempilo, i-blockchain isetshenziswa ukulawula amarekhodi wezempilo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwemiguli lugcinwa ngokuphepha, ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka, futhi lungafinyelelwa kalula ngababheki bezempilo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, i-blockchain ithuthukiswe emkhakheni wezokuthengisa. Izinkampani zifaka izinhlelo ezisebenzisa i-blockchain ukulandelela imikhiqizo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi ababukeli bazi ukuthi imikhiqizo etholiwe ivela kuphi, nokuthi ngabe iyahambisana nezindinganiso eziphezulu. Lokhu kube usizo olukhulu ekunciphiseni ukukhwabanisa, njengoba abathengi bengakwazi ukuqinisekisa izimpahla ezingekho emthethweni. Ngalesi sikhathi, i-blockchain itholakala nakumkhakha wezokuthutha. Amathuluzi athuthukisiwe aklanywa ukuze alandele izimpahla ngesikhathi sangempela, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi zifinyelela kumakhasimende ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Le ndlela ibonisa ukuthi, nangaphandle kwezimali, i-blockchain iyithuluzi elinamandla lokuphucula izinqubo emikhakheni eyahlukene, ikhulisa ukusebenza kahle, futhi ikhulisa ukwethenjwa phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi. Ngakho-ke, nakuba i-blockchain iqale njengendlela yokuphatha imali, umbhalo wayo omkhulu uye uba yinsika emikhakheni eminingi, udlulisela esikhathini esizayo sokusebenza okwejwayelekile nokuqhubekayo. Ubufakazi balesi sikhathi buveza ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze buphendule izidingo zomphakathi, futhi lokho kuchaza impumelelo yalo empilweni yethu yanamuhla.

text: Indima yemidlalo yendabuko ekwakheni ubumbano emphakathini Umbuzo 1: Yini imidlalo yendabuko? Imidlalo yendabuko ingelinye lamagugu omlando, evame ukudlalwa ukuze kugcinwe amasiko namasiko omphakathi. Le midlalo ivame ukudlalwa emicimbini ehlukene futhi ibonisa ubuqotho bendawo. Umbuzo 2: Yini indima yemidlalo yendabuko emphakathini? Imidlalo yendabuko ikhulisa ubumbano, ibandakanya abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi iyindlela yokuxhuma abantu. Abantu badlale ndawonye, bakhumbulane ngezimfundiso, futhi baphinde banikeze intshisekelo emlandweni wabo. Umbuzo 3: Zithinta kanjani izizukulwane ezahlukene? Imidlalo yendabuko iyinsiza yokudlulisa ulwazi phakathi kwezizukulwane. Izingane zifunda ngemvelaphi nomlando wezindawo zabo, kuyilapho abadala bejabulisa futhi behlaziya izindlela ezihambisana nokwenziwa. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe imidlalo yendabuko ingavusa impilo yomphakathi? Yebo, imidlalo yendabuko ingasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngesikhathi semicimbi, lapho abantu bejoyina, behlanganyela, futhi befaka izandla ekuphumeleleni kwezinjongo zomphakathi. Umbuzo 5: Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi imidlalo yendabuko iqhubeke isekhona? Ukuze imidlalo yendabuko iqhubeke, kubalulekile ukuhlinzekwa ngezinsiza, ukufundiswa kwezingane, nokuxhaswa komphakathi. Ukubamba imicimbi njalo nokuhlonipha le midlalo kuyasiza ekugcineni isiko. Umbuzo 6: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise indima yemidlalo yendabuko? Singenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuhlela imicimbi, ukufundisa imidlalo ezikoleni, nokuheha abantu abaningi ukuba babambe iqhaza. Imidlalo yendabuko iyindlela yokwakha ubumbano oluqinile emphakathini.

text: Ukusetshenziswa kwezimali zedijithali (cryptocurrency) emabhizinisini amancane kudinga ukubhekwa ngokucophelela, njengoba lezi zimali zikhula ngokushesha, zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha futhi zikhulisa amathuba okukhula. Njengoba umhlaba uhamba phambili, izinkanyezi ezinjenge-Bitcoin ne-Ethereum ziyaqhubeka nokuduma, zenza ukuqashwa kwezimali zedijithali kube yindlela ethokozisayo yokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane. Ngokwesibonelo, amabhizinisi amancane angazuza kakhulu ekunciphiseni izindleko zokuhweba. Ngokusebenzisa izimali zedijithali, umphakathi ungagwema izinkokhelo ezinzima ezihlanganiswe nezinhlelo zebhange zasendaweni. Lokhu kudala umfaniswano obalulekile wokwenza ibhizinisi, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa. Ngaphezulu kwalokho, izimali zedijithali ziwusizo kumabhizinisi athengisa kumakhasimende avela emhlabeni wonke, njengoba zibuswa yizimakethe ezisemhlabeni jikelele, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emakethe yezezimali. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezimali zedijithali akukhululi amabhizinisi efuqulwe. Ukuntuleka kokwaziswa, izigameko zokukhwabanisa, kanye ne-volatility echazwe ngalesi sikhathi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Amabhizinisi amancane adinga ukuqonda lezi zinkinga ukuze akwazi ukusiza izinqumo zokuthi angazisebenzisa kanjani lezi zimali ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, ngikholelwa ukuthi, uma amabhizinisi amancane ewafaka kahle, izimali zedijithali zingaba yisikhombisa sesikhathi esizayo kwezokuhweba. Ukukhetha kahle nokuqonda kahle izingozi kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokuphumelela kwayo. Jikelele, lezi zimali zedijithali ziyasivula emaphethelweni amasha, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sizijabulele kahle.

text: Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wemidlalo ye-eSports entsheni yaseNingizimu Afrika Emhlabeni wesimanje, umphakathi ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ngenxa yobuchwepheshe, futhi imidlalo ye-eSports ithole ukugxila okukhulu, ikakhulukazi entsheni yaseNingizimu Afrika. I-eSports, okukhulunywa ngayo lapha, ibhekisela emidlalweni yevidiyo edlalwa ngamathimba noma ngabanye abantu, futhi inezimpikiswano eziningi lapho abadlali besebenzisa amakhono abo ukuze baphumelele. Umthelela wemidlalo ye-eSports entabeni yentsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ungaphezu kokuwina imiklomelo. Okokuqala, imidlalo ye-eSports ikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono athile, njengokucabanga ngokushesha, ukuhlela, nokusebenza kahle ngokubambisana. Lezi zinto zinomthelela omuhle emsebenzini nasemfundo, njengoba izinkampani eziningi zifuna abafakizolo abaneqiniso ekuxhumaneni nasekuhlanganyeleni. Ngaphandle kwalokho, i-eSports ibuye iveze amathuba amasha emisebenzi. Njengoba umkhakha uqhubeka nokukhula, kudingeka abantu abanohlu olubanzi lwamakhono, kuhlanganise noxhaso lwezobuchwepheshe, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, kanye nezezimali. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi emisha, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha abakhula ezingeni lemidlalwana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo ye-eSports iyinsika yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Abadlali bahlala bexhumene nabanye, bekhuluma ngezinhlelo zabo nemiphumela, futhi bakha ubudlelwano obunempilo. Lokhu kusiza ekufundeni okuhle kwezemidlalo, ngakolunye uhlanga, kuphinde kube negalelo ekupheleni kwezinkinga ezihlobene nezehlakalo njengezinkinga zokucindezeleka nezokwehluleka. Ekugcineni, umthelela wemidlalo ye-eSports emnothweni nasekuhlangenwe nakho kwemiphakathi yaseNingizimu Afrika ungachazwa njengowesikhathi eside. I-eSports, njengengxenye yezenzakalo zesimanje, ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onokuxhumana okuhle kanye nezinkanyezi ezisha emkhakheni wezokungcebeleka.

text: Izinselelo zokuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu ezinkundleni zedijithali Namuhla, ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha, kodwa lokhu kuza nezinkinga eziningi, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu. Izinkundla zedijithali, ezifana nezokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngemininingwane, kodwa lezi zinsiza zithwele umthwalo omkhulu wokuvikela le mininingwane. Okokuqala, ukungavikeleki kwedatha kubalulekile. Izinkampani eziningi azinayo imithombo eyanele yokuvikela imininingwane yomsebenzisi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezinsongo eziningi, ezifana nezokuhlasela kwe-cyber, lapho abahlaseli bethola khona ukufinyelela kalula kumakhasi e-inthanethi. Lokhu kudala ukungathembeki kubasebenzisi, okwenza kube nzima ukuvuma ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Okwesibili, imithetho yokuvikela idatha iyashintsha njalo. Imithetho efana ne-General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) e-Europe ibeka izidingo ezinzima, kodwa ezindaweni eziningi, imithetho ayikabi khona noma ayiqinile. Lokhu kudala ubunzima ekuphatheni idatha, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ukuhamba phakathi kwemithetho ehlukahlukene, okungaholela ekutheni zingawuvikeli kahle umsebenzisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungazi kahle kwabantu mayelana nezingozi zokwabelana ngemininingwane kuyinkinga enkulu. Abantu abaningi abazi kahle ukuthi imininingwane yabo ingasetshenziswa kanjani, futhi lokhu kubavulela amathuba okukhwabanisa. Ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvikela idatha yabo. Ekugcineni, nakuba izinkundla zedijithali zikhuthaza ukwabelana, kubalulekile ukuthi ziqhubele phambili izinqubomgomo ezicacile nezisebenzayo zokuvikela idatha yomuntu siqu. Ukuze sithole ikusasa elinempilo, kumele sikhulume ngalezi zinselelo futhi sizame ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela imininingwane yethu, futhi sibe nokwaneliseka ekusebenziseni izinkundla zedijithali.

text: Umthelela wokukhula kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo UThandiwe Moyo, oneminyaka engu-28 ubudala, ungumfundi onothando lwezobuchwepheshe ophakathi kokuba umqondisi wezobuchwepheshe eNkampanini Yezokuxhumana. Waqala ukuthola izinzuzo ezinhle zezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ngesikhathi eqala umsebenzi. Ngemva kokuhlangana nabanye abasebenzi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, waqonda ukuthi lezi zindawo zenza kube lula ukuhwebelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, nezinsiza zokufunda. Ngokubambisana nabanye, uThandiwe wathola amathuba amaningi okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nokwakha imisebenzi emisha. Ukwanda kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo kumenze waba nesikhathi esithe xaxa sokucabanga ngezimakethe ezintsha. Uthanda ukuthi lezi zindawo zikhuthaza ukwakhiwa kobuchwepheshe obusha, okwenza kube lula kubaqalayo ukuthi bakhe amaphrojekthi amasha. UThandiwe uthi, "Ukusebenza ezindaweni ezihlanganyelwayo kudlulela phambili ekwakheni umphakathi osebenzayo. Kulungile ukusiza abanye, futhi ngithola ulwazi olubalulekile olusiza ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zami." Ngalesi sizathu, ukholelwa ukuthi lezi zindawo zikhombisa ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho abantu bezosebenzisana khona ukuze bakhe umhlaba omuhle, onobuchwepheshe obuphakeme, nokuhlanganisa wonke umuntu. Ngokubuka kwesikhathi esizayo, uThandiwe ubheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ukuze zibe ngaphezulu kokuba izindawo zokusebenza, kodwa zibe yizikhungo zokudala, zokubambisana, nokukhula.

text: Ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kubathengisi abazimele Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili ngokushesha, futhi lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emkhakheni wokuthengisa. Ngalesi sikhathi, abathengisi abazimele bathola ithuba elikhulu lokukhula futhi bakhe ibhizinisi labo online. Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi lesi sikhathi sithokozisa, kodwa futhi sinesibopho esikhulu. Okokuqala, ukuthengisa online kunikeza abathengisi abazimele ithuba lokufinyelela emakethe enkulu ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuphatha izitolo zomzimba. Lokhu kuhlanganisa namathuba okuthengisa kwezinye izifunda nezwe lonke, okwenza kube lula ukuheha amakhasimende amasha. Ngokusebenzisa izinkundla ezahlukene zokuxhumana, abathengisi bangakwazi ukufinyelela abantu abaningi, futhi lokhu kuhle kakhulu ekwandiseni ibhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphathwa kokuthengisa online kwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza ezisemqoka. Abathengisi bangabheka kalula ukuthengiswa kwabo, izidingo zamakhasimende, nokuphendula imibuzo ngasikhathi sinye. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile namakhasimende, okwandisa amathuba okwenza imali. Nokho, ukukhula komkhakha kudinga ukuthi abathengisi bazibophezele ekwenzeni ucwaningo olujulile. Ukukhula komhlaba wokuthengisa online kuhilela izinselelo ezahlukene, okubandakanya ukuncintisana okukhulu. Ngakho-ke, abathengisi abazimele kufanele babe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokumaketha, ukuze bakwazi ukugcina indawo yabo emakethe. Ngokubuka konke, ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kubathengisi abazimele kuveza amathuba amaningi. Kodwa ke, ukuze baphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi bazivocavoce, balandele izitayela ezintsha, futhi baqhubeke nokufunda. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphumelele ezimakethe ezishintshashintshayo, futhi balondoloze ibhizinisi labo isikhathi eside.

text: Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe bokuphrinta be-3D embonini Ubuchwepheshe bokuphrinta be-3D sekubeke isisekelo esikhulu ezinhlelweni ezahlukene ezifana nezembatho, ezokwakha, imishini, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Le ndlela yokukhiqiza ikhombisa indlela entsha yokwakha izinto, ivumela ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo ngendlela ethuthukile. Ezinye zezindlela ezijwayelekile zokuphrinta be-3D zifaka phakathi ukuklama imodeli yomkhiqizo nge-software, bese umshini uphrinta le modeli ngokwakha imisebe eyahlukene. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi sokukhiqiza, kwenza kube lula ukwenza izingxenye eziyinkimbinkimbi, futhi kuthuthukisa ukunemba. Emkhakheni wezokwakha, ukuphrinta be-3D kusiza ekuhlinzekeni ngama-modules ezakhiwo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokwakha izakhiwo ezahlukene. Kwezamabhizinisi, izinkampani zisebenzisa leli thuluzi ukwenza izicubu zokuhlola, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela ye-Prototype ngokushesha ngaphambi kokukhiqiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphrinta be-3D kuthuthukiswe ezimbonini zemithi, lapho kudalwe khona izitho zomzimba ezizenzakalelayo nezisetshenziswa eziningi kumkhakha wezempilo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuqambi besikhathi esizayo busebenza, futhi ukusakazwa kobuchwepheshe bokuphrinta be-3D kuzothuthukisa imikhiqizo nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zindlela ezintsha kukhombisa indlela esheshayo yokukhiqiza, okuholela ekwenzeni umkhiqizo ophucukile, kanye nokunciphisa izindleko, okusiza izinkampani ukuhambisana nezidingo eziqhubekayo zemakethe.

text: Ucwaningo ngezindlela abantu abasebenzisa ngazo ama-smartwatch Ama-smartwatch asezandleni zethu, futhi akuyona nje imfashini, kodwa futhi kube yithuluzi elibalulekile empilweni yethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu banikela kakhulu ekusebenziseni lezi zinsiza, futhi indlela abasebenzisa ngayo ama-smartwatch iyathakazelisa. Okokuqala, ama-smartwatch asiza abantu ukuthi bahlale bephapheme. Ngokuthola izaziso zomlayezo, izikhumbuzo, nezaziso zokuhamba, abantu bangakwazi ukuphendula nasekusebenzeni kwabo ngaphandle kokuphuma kwi-skin. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi emsebenzini, lapho kokuhlala uqaphile nezinsuku ezibucayi zikhona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-smartwatch akhuthaza ukusindisa impilo. Ngokulandela izinga lokushisa komzimba, imithambo yegazi, nokuzivocavoca, abantu bathola ulwazi oluqondile mayelana nempilo yabo. Lokhu kubavumela ukuthi benze izinqumo ezingcono zokudla, ukuzivocavoca, nokuhlala bejabulile. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lokhu kuthuthukisa impilo yabo, kuyilapho kunciphisa amathuba okuba nezinkinga zempilo ezinzima. Futhi, ama-smartwatch ayisikhumbuzo esihle sokusebenzisa isikhathi kahle. Ngokusebenza kwezikhathi ezithile, abantu bangakwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi komsebenzi nempilo yomuntu siqu. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ibhalansi empilweni, ezehlenga emphakathini ngoba abantu abanesikhathi sokuphumula bazokwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabanye. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Kunesidingo sokuba siqaphele ukuze singabavumi ukuthi ama-smartwatch akhiphe isikhathi sethu. Kukho umqondo obalulekile wokuthi kufanele sizwisise futhi sihloniphe imizwa yethu nempilo yethu yengqondo. Ngamafuphi, ama-smartwatch anikeza amathuba amaningi, kodwa kufanele sibe neqhaza lokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza ngokuhlakanipha. Ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu, sithumele imiyalezo yethu, futhi sakhe ibhalansi empilweni yethu, kudingeka siqapidise amanye ama-smartwatch ethu. Lolu cwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi ama-smartwatch, uma esetshenziswa kahle, angaba usizo olukhulu kithina sonke.

text: Ekukhuleni komhlaba wezobuchwepheshe, ama-smartwatch ahlale edlalela indima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu. Ngemuva kokwaziswa kwawo kuqala emhlabeni, okwakhiwe ngama-digital watch, abantu baqala ukuthola izindlela ezintsha zokuwasebenzisa. Njengoba umqondo wokuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe ufinyelela kwabantu abaningi, ama-smartwatch akhula waba nezinselelo eziningi. Ngaphakathi kweminyaka yama-2010, ama-smartwatch aqala ukujabulisa abantu abaningi, engakhawulile emisebenzini yawo ngokukodwa. Asetshenziswa kakhulu ukuze kubonakale isikhathi, kodwa abantu baqala nokuwasebenzisa ukuze balandele impilo yabo. Izici ezifana nokuhlola izinga lempilo, ukuhamba, nokugcina izibalo zamasiko eziphilayo, kwenza ama-smartwatch abe yinto ebalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngonyaka ka-2015, ama-smartwatch aqala ukutholwa ezimakethe eziningi, futhi abantu bavele baqonda ukuthi angabasiza kanjani ekulandeleni izimpilo zabo. Abaningi baqala ukuthola izinzuzo zokugcina izibalo ziphucukile, futhi lokhu kwashintsha indlela abahlala nomsebenzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-smartwatch aba nezinye izici ezinjengezaziso ezivela ezinhlelweni, ukuhamba UV, nokukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ngezinsiza zokusebenza. Ngaphandle kokuthi abantu basebenzisa ama-smartwatch njengemishini yokwenziwa, kwaqhubeka nokufinyelela emnothweni. Lokhu kuwufakazi wokuthi noveli yokudlulisela amaminithi ezinsuku zamanje, ama-smartwatch aseqhulwini njengomngane owaziwayo emisebenzini yansuku zonke. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi usayidala ubuqotho bokungenelela okuqhubekayo, njengoba ama-smartwatch eqhubeka nokukhulisa impilo yabantu ngezindlela eziningi. Thina njengomphakathi, sikhuluma ngekusasa elikhazimulayo lemidlalose futhi siyakhumbula ukuthi, ukusuka esikhathini esidlule, ama-smartwatch abambe iqhaza elikhulu empilweni yethu.

text: Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga Q: Yini imidlalo yokucabanga? A: Imidlalo yokucabanga ibandakanya imidlalo edinga ukucabanga okujulile, ukuhlela, nokwenza izinqumo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imidlalo efana neChess, Go, kanye neScrabble. Q: Yini eyenza imidlalo yokudlala amabhodi ibe nentshisekelo? A: Imidlalo yokudlala amabhodi inikeza ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kudlalwa emaphakathini. Iphinde ibe nendlela yokuthuthukisa amakhono okucabanga, ukuhlela, nokuxhumana. Q: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokudlala imidlalo yokucabanga? A: Ziningi izinzuzo, kuhlanganise nokuthuthukisa amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokunciphisa ukucindezeleka. Imidlalo yokucabanga ingasiza ekuthuthukiseni umqondo, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni. Q: Kukhona yini izinselelo emkhakheni wezokudlala amabhodi? A: Yebo, kunezinselelo eziningi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuncintisana okuqinile, izinguquko ezisheshayo ezimakethe, kanye nezidingo zokwakha imidlalo ethokozisayo nehluke. Abadali bemidlalo badinga ukuhlala bephambili ukuze bahlale benomthelela. Q: Yiziphi izitayela ezintsha ezivela emkhakheni? A: Kukhona ukwanda kokuhlanganiswa kwemidlalo yokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yevidiyo, kanye nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obufana ne-AR (Augmented Reality) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ulwazi lomsebenzisi. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha kubadali bemidlalo. Q: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lemidlalo yokucabanga? A: Ngibona ikusasa lemidlalo yokucabanga likhanya, njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokufuna izindlela zokuxhumana nokuzijabulisa. Imidlalo yokudlala amabhodi izohlala ibalulekile, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini.

text: Indima yemidlalo yendabuko ekwakheni ubumbano emphakathini Kujabulela abantu abaningi imidlalo yendabuko, ehlobene nempilo yempucuko yethu. UThabo Mthembu, umphakathi ophuma eMzimkhulu, ungumuntu owaqonda kahle le ndima. Njengomfundisi wedolobha, uThabo usebenze iminyaka eminingi ukuze aqinise ubumbano phakathi kwabantu bendawo. Ukubamba imicimbi yemidlalo yendabuko, uThabo usungule imishado, imikhosi, kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi ezididiyela ukudlala izinhlelo ezahlukene ezifana nomjaho wezimoto, ukuphepha kwenhlangano, kanye nemidlalo yokudansa. Le midlalo ivuselela ubungane, ibuyisela izinkumbulo ezinhle zabantu, futhi igqugquzela ukuhloniphana phakathi kwezizukulwane. UThabo uthe, "Imidlalo yendabuko akukhona nje ukuzijabulisa, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu." Njengoba edlulisa izifundo ezibalulekile ezivela ezinkolelweni zendabuko, uThabo ushukumisa umoya wokubambisana futhi uphakamisa umqondo wokuhlonipha. Ngaphezu kokuthuthukisa imisebenzi yomphakathi, imidlalo yendabuko inikeza ithuba lokufundisa amalungelo abantu, ivuselela ukuzibophezela kwabantu ukuze bakhuthaze ukuthula nokubumbana. UThabo uyasebenza nempumelelo ukwakha umphakathi onokubambisana, uphumelela ekwakheni ubumbano obuhlala buqinile ngokusebenzisa imidlalo yendabuko. Ngalesi sizathu, indima yezenzakalo zakho iyigugu emiphakathini enengqondo, ibhalela izinkumbulo ezinhle ezinobungane.

text: Izinselelo zokuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu ezinkundleni zedijithali Ngiyingcweti kwezobuchwepheshe, ngithokozisa ukuphila kwami ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zedijithali. Ngithola ukuthi izinkampani eziningi azigcini kahle ngemininingwane yami, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abaphangi baphumelele ekutholeni idatha yami. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokungaphephile, njengoba ngihlala ngicabanga ukuthi ngabe ngiyavikeleka yini. Okwesibili, ukungabi nolwazi olufanele mayelana nezindlela zokuvikela idatha kuyinselelo enkulu. Abantu abaningi abazi kahle ukuthi bangayivikela kanjani idatha yabo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni baphule imithetho yokuphepha. Ngiyazi ukuthi kufanele ngifunde futhi ngiqonde izinqubo zokuvikela, kodwa lokhu kudinga isikhathi nemizamo. Ekugcineni, izinkundla zedijithali zihlala zishintsha, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi ngihlale ngibuyekeza ulwazi lwami. Ngiyazi ukuthi ukuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu akupheli, kodwa kudinga ukuzinikela okuqhubekayo. Ngakho, ngizama ukuhlala ngiqaphele, ngifunde, futhi ngithuthukise izindlela zami zokuvikela idatha, ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi ngihlala ngiphephile ezinkundleni zedijithali.

text: Hheyi, unjani? Ngicabanga ukuthi sithole ithuba elihle lokukhuluma ngalezi zinguquko ezithinta indlela esilalela ngayo umsakazo. Ngabe ubona kanjani? Ngiyazi, uma sikhuluma ngomsakazo, sikhumbula izinsuku lapho sithola khona iziteshi ezithile kuphela, futhi sasingakwazi ukulalela kuphela uma sikhona eduze kwedivayisi yethu. Manje, njengoba izinkundla zokusakaza zikhula, konke sekushintshile. Uhlelo lokulalela umsakazo lukhululekile kakhulu. Ungalalela noma yini, noma kuphi, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Lokhu kuguqule indlela esithokozisa ngayo umsakazo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkundla ezifana neSpotify, Apple Music, nezinye zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumasiko ahlukahlukene? Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abantu baziqhenye ngezinkanyezi zabo zomculo, futhi baphinde bahlale bejabulile. Futhi, akukhona nje kuphela umculo. Izinkundla zokusakaza zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumaphodikhasti, izinhlelo zokuxoxa, nezindaba. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungathola ulwazi oluningi, futhi ungakhetha lokho okuthandayo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kuguqula kanjani indlela esithola ngayo ulwazi? Ngiyazi, abanye bethu basathanda ukulalela umsakazo ngendlela yakudala, kodwa ngempela, izinkundla zikusiza ukuthi ube nezinye izinketho. Ngakho, ngabe sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo entsha yokulalela umsakazo? Ngiyavuma, izinguquko zikhona, futhi zenza kube mnandi kakhulu. Ngabe unayo imicabango ethile ngalokhu? Ngithanda ukuzwa ukuthi ubona kanjani lezi zinguquko.

text: Hheyi, unjani? Ngifuna ukukhuluma nawe ngendaba ethokozisayo—ukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi. Ucabanga ukuthi lokhu kukhula kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu? Ngicabanga ukuthi kunjalo! Okokuqala, izimoto zikagesi zinciphisa ukungcoliswa komoya. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi. Ngabe ubone kanjani ukuthi umoya ubukeka? Ngiyazi, abanye bethu sithanda ukuhamba ngemoto, kodwa uma sithola izimoto ezisebenzisa ugesi, sizokwazi ukunciphisa lezo zinkinga. Futhi, cabanga ngempilo yomnotho. Ukukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi kuzoletha amathuba emisebenzi! Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bazothola imisebenzi emisha emikhakheni efana nokwakha, ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo, nokunye okuningi. Ngabe ubone izinkampani eziningi ziqala ukwakha izimoto zikagesi? Lokhu kuhle kakhulu! Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle. Ugesi, lapho sikhuluma ngawo, kudinga izinsiza ezithile. Amaphrojekthi okwakha iziteshi zokuhlola ugesi adinga imali. Ngabe sikhona isixazululo esingcono? Lokhu kudinga ukuba uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo basebenze ndawonye. Ngakho, ukuphela kwendaba, ukukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi kunemiphumela emihle kakhulu, kodwa kudinga ukuthi siqaphele futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezinhle ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sithola inzuzo enkulu kulokhu. Ucabanga ukuthi sizokwazi yini?

text: Ucwaningo ngezindlela abantu abasebenzisa ama-smartwatch Ama-smartwatch sebecashelwe ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke, kodwa kubalulekile ukuzibuza ukuthi zisetshenziswa kanjani. Abantu basebenzisa ama-smartwatch ngezindlela eziningi, futhi lezi zindlela ziwusizo kumphakathi ngezindlela ezahlukene. Okokuqala, ama-smartwatch asiza abantu ekulandeleni impilo yabo. Abaningi basebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze balandele imisebenzi yabo yokuzivocavoca, njengezinyathelo ezithathwayo, ukuhamba emsebenzini, noma ukufaka izikhumbuzo phakathi nezikhathi zokuphumula. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu baqaphele impilo yabo kangcono, bunciphise izinga le-Obesity, futhi bagcine imithwalo yabo isesimweni esihle. Okwesibili, ama-smartwatch enza imisebenzi yansuku zonke ibe lula. Ngokusebenzisa ama-notifications, abantu bangathola imiyalezo, izikhumbuzo, kanye nezinhlelo zezenzakalo ngaphandle kokudinga ukufaka ifoni. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kubantu abahamba ngebhasi, abahamba ngezinyawo, noma abagibeli, ngoba bangathola izikhumbuzo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwama-smartwatch. Abanye abantu bakhathazekile ngezinselelo zobumfihlo, njengoba ama-smartwatch evamise ukuhlaziya imininingwane yomsebenzisi. Lokhu kungaba nezinkinga uma imininingwane ingenziwa kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-smartwatch adinga ukukhokhelwa, okungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokufinyelela. Abanye abantu abakwazi ukukhokhela lesi sikhala, okuholela ekubeni kube nzima ukufinyelela ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme. Ngokuqhubekayo, ama-smartwatch anemiphumela emihle nezinkinga. Kodwa-ke, uma abantu beqaphela indlela abawasebenzisa ngayo, bangakwazi ukuqhubeka benza impilo yabo ibe ngcono. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukukhetha indlela yokusebenzisa ama-smartwatch kuyahluka kumuntu nomuntu, futhi lokhu kumele kube yinto abathengi ebalulekile ukuyicabangela.

text: Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo (audiobooks) Ngokukhula kwesikhathi esitolo, imikhakha eminingi ibonakala ilandela izinguquko ezinkulu. Omunye wemikhakha ethokozisayo kakhulu kulezi zinsuku nguhlelo lwezincwadi ezilalelwayo. Lezi zincwadi, ezingalalelwa kuzo, zikhombisa indlela entsha yokufunda, eyenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bafunde bengenalo ukuhamba nencwadi ethile. Ngokubona kwami, izincwadi ezilalelwayo zinesithombe esihle kakhulu empilweni yamanje, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala bengenakho isikhathi sokubhala noma sokuhlala phansi bafunde. Kunezizathu eziningi ezenza izincwadi ezilalelwayo zibe yindlela yokufunda eyanelisayo. Okokuqala, zokwenza kube lula ukufunda imithombo eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ungalalela incwadi ngesikhathi uhamba emotweni, uyosebenza, noma ngisho nasemsebenzini. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi oluningi ngezikhathi ezihlukahlukene. Okwesibili, izincwadi ezilalelwayo ziwusizo kulabo abaphelezela ubunzima bokufunda. Abantu abanemibandela ethile, njengezinye izifo noma ukungakwazi ukufunda kahle, bangakuthola kulula ukunikeza lezi zincwadi ezizwakalayo ithuba lokuphila. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, khumbula ukuthi lezi zincwadi zidala indlela entsha yokuxhumana nababhali. Umdlali wezwi ungashintsha umqondo wesifanekiso, evuleka ngamazwi akhe, okuholela ekubeni uhlu lwezincwadi ezithokozisayo luhlelwe ngempumelelo. Lokhu akugcini nje ekuthokoziseni, kodwa futhi kudala umuzwa wobudlelwano phakathi komlobi nomlali. Ngakho-ke, sengiyavuma, umbukiso wemikhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ukhombisa ukuthi ukuqhubeka nezifiso zokufunda akuphumi ekufundeni kahle, kodwa nakumaudio athokozisayo. Umkhakha wawela obala, ubonisa ukusha okuhlobene nezokuxhumana, futhi ugcwalisa izikhala eziningi ezindabeni zethu ezithinta imizwa nemicabango. Ngaleso sikhathi, leli thuba lokukhula kwezincwadi ezilalelwayo liyinhlangano ephumelela kakhulu yokwakha umphakathi ofunda kakhulu.

text: Ukuhlaziywa kokwanda kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini, uThandi Mthembu ungumcwaningi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ogxile ekwakheni nasekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwama-robot embonini. UThandi wazalelwa eThekwini, lapho aqala khona ukuthakasela ubuchwepheshe kusukela ebuncaneni. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zezeMfundo eNyuvesi yaseNatal, wathola ithuba lokusebenza emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokukhiqiza. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza, uThandi uqaphele ukuthi ama-robot angakhulisa ukusebenza kwemikhiqizo, anciphise izindleko, futhi akhulise ukukhiqiza. Uhlaziye izindlela ezahlukene zokusebenzisa ama-robot, ahlola izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nokufakwa kwama-robot emigqeni yokukhiqiza. UThandi ukholelwa ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwama-robot emsebenzini kungaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza, okwenza imboni ibe namandla kakhulu. UThandi uphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo ezihlanganisa ama-robot, ezithuthukisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Uhlale efuna izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto, futhi ubona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bama-robot buvulelekile ekuthuthukiseni imikhakha eminingi, kuhlanganise nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokudla. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi ube yisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bama-robot bungathuthukisa kanjani imboni, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ukwakhiwa kobuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo kudinga ubuchule, ubuhlakani, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. UThandi Mthembu ungumholi ophambili emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi ubheke phambili ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile lama-robot embonini.
